verses.zh: 牛认识主人，驴认识主人的槽，以色列却不认识；我的民却不留意。

verses.en: Ah sinful nation, a people loaded with iniquity, offspring of evildoers, children who deal corruptly! They have forsaken the LORD. They have despised the Holy One of Israel. They are estranged and backward.
verses.zh: 嗐！犯罪的国民，担着罪孽的百姓；行恶的种类，败坏的儿女！他们离弃耶和华，藐视以色列的圣者，与他生疏，往后退步。

verses.zh: 你们为甚么屡次悖逆，还要受责打吗？你们已经满头疼痛，全心发昏。

verses.zh: 从脚掌到头顶，没有一处完全的，尽是伤口、青肿，与新打的伤痕，都没有收口，没有缠裹，也没有用膏滋润。

verses.en: Your country is desolate. Your cities are burned with fire. Strangers devour your land in your presence and it is desolate, as overthrown by strangers.
verses.zh: 你们的地土已经荒凉；你们的城邑被火焚毁。你们的田地在你们眼前为外邦人所侵吞，既被外邦人倾覆就成为荒凉。

verses.en: “Let’s go up against Judah, and tear it apart, and let’s divide it among ourselves, and set up a king within it, even the son of Tabeel.”
verses.zh: 说：我们可以上去攻击犹大，扰乱它，攻破它，在其中立他比勒的儿子为王。

words.g: in + Jehudah , the name of five Israelites
and + to be  disgusted or anxious + +her/its
Tabeel, the name of a Syrian and of a Persian

verses.en: This is what the Lord GOD says: “It shall not stand, neither shall it happen.”
verses.zh: 所以主耶和华如此说：这所谋的必立不住，也不得成就。

verses.en: For the head of Syria is Damascus, and the head of Damascus is Rezin. Within sixty-five years Ephraim shall be broken in pieces, so that it shall not be a people.
verses.zh: 原来亚兰的首城是大马士革；大马士革的首领是利汛。（六十五年之内，以法莲必然破坏，不再成为国民。）

words.g: Aram or Syria, and its inhabitants
Retsin, the name of a Syrian and of an Israelite
and + in + behind, on behalf of

verses.en: The head of Ephraim is Samaria, and the head of Samaria is Remaliah’s son. If you will not believe, surely you shall not be established.’”
verses.zh: 以法莲的首城是撒马利亚；撒马利亚的首领是利玛利的儿子。你们若是不信，定然不得立稳。』」

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.en: The LORD spoke again to Ahaz, saying,
verses.zh: 耶和华又晓谕亚哈斯说：

words.g: Achaz, the name of a Jewish king and of an Israelite

verses.en: “Ask a sign of the LORD your God; ask it either in the depth, or in the height above.”
verses.zh: 「你向耶和华―你的神求一个兆头：或求显在深处，或求显在高处。」

words.g: to + the upper part, used only adverbially with prefix upward

verses.en: But Ahaz said, “I won’t ask. I won’t tempt the LORD.”
verses.zh: 亚哈斯说：「我不求；我不试探耶和华。」

words.g: Achaz, the name of a Jewish king and of an Israelite

verses.en: He said, “Listen now, house of David. Is it not enough for you to try the patience of men, that you will try the patience of my God also?
verses.zh: 以赛亚说：「大卫家啊，你们当听！你们使人厌烦岂算小事，还要使我的神厌烦吗？

verses.en: Therefore the Lord himself will give you a sign. Behold, the virgin will conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.
verses.zh: 因此，主自己要给你们一个兆头，必有童女怀孕生子，给他起名叫以马内利（就是神与我们同在的意思）。

words.g: Immanuel, a type name of Isaiah's son
Immanuel, a type name of Isaiah's son

verses.en: He shall eat butter and honey when he knows to refuse the evil and choose the good.
verses.zh: 到他晓得弃恶择善的时候，他必吃奶油与蜂蜜。

verses.en: For before the child knows to refuse the evil and choose the good, the land whose two kings you abhor shall be forsaken.
verses.zh: 因为在这孩子还不晓得弃恶择善之先，你所憎恶的那二王之地必致见弃。

words.g: the + a boy , from the age of infancy to adolescence
thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: The LORD will bring on you, on your people, and on your father’s house days that have not come, from the day that Ephraim departed from Judah, even the king of Assyria.
verses.zh: 耶和华必使亚述王攻击你的日子临到你和你的百姓，并你的父家，自从以法莲离开犹大以来，未曾有这样的日子。

words.g: father, in a literal and immediate + +you/your
Jehudah , the name of five Israelites
Ashshur, the second son of Shem

verses.en: It will happen in that day that the LORD will whistle for the fly that is in the uttermost part of the rivers of Egypt, and for the bee that is in the land of Assyria.
verses.zh: 「那时，耶和华要发嘶声，使埃及江河源头的苍蝇和亚述地的蜂子飞来；

words.g: to be shrill, i.e. to whistle or hiss
Mitsrajim, i.e. Upper and Lower Egypt
Ashshur, the second son of Shem

verses.en: They shall come, and shall all rest in the desolate valleys, in the clefts of the rocks, on all thorn hedges, and on all pastures.
verses.zh: 都必飞来，落在荒凉的谷内、磐石的穴里，和一切荆棘篱笆中，并一切的草场上。

words.g: and + to rest, i.e. settle down
in + a stream, especially a winter torrent
the + a craggy rock, literally or figuratively

verses.en: In that day the Lord will shave with a razor that is hired in the parts beyond the River, even with the king of Assyria, the head and the hair of the feet; and it shall also consume the beard.
verses.zh: 「那时，主必用大河外赁的剃头刀，就是亚述王，剃去头发和脚上的毛，并要剃净胡须。

words.g: to be bald, i.e.  to shave
Ashshur, the second son of Shem

verses.en: It shall happen in that day that a man shall keep alive a young cow, and two sheep.
verses.zh: 「那时，一个人要养活一只母牛犊，两只母绵羊；

words.g: to live, whether literally or figuratively
a  calf, especially one nearly grown

verses.en: It shall happen, that because of the abundance of milk which they shall give he shall eat butter, for everyone will eat butter and honey that is left within the land.
verses.zh: 因为出的奶多，他就得吃奶油，在境内所剩的人都要吃奶油与蜂蜜。

words.g: the + to jut over or exceed
in + the nearest part, i.e. the center

verses.en: It will happen in that day that every place where there were a thousand vines worth a thousand silver shekels, will be for briers and thorns.
verses.zh: 「从前，凡种一千棵葡萄树、值银一千舍客勒的地方，到那时必长荆棘和蒺藜。

words.g: and + to + scrub or trash, i.e. wild growth of weeds or briers

verses.en: People will go there with arrows and with bow, because all the land will be briers and thorns.
verses.zh: 人上那里去，必带弓箭，因为遍地满了荆棘和蒺藜。

words.g: and + in + a bow, forshooting  or the iris
and + scrub or trash, i.e. wild growth of weeds or briers

verses.en: All the hills that were cultivated with the hoe, you shall not come there for fear of briers and thorns; but it shall be for the sending out of oxen, and for sheep to tread on.”
verses.zh: 所有用锄刨挖的山地，你因怕荆棘和蒺藜，不敢上那里去；只可成了放牛之处，为羊践踏之地。」

words.g: to arrange as a battle, a vineyard
and + scrub or trash, i.e. wild growth of weeds or briers
to + a sending out, i.e.  presentation
a member of a flock, i.e. a sheep or goat

verses.en: The LORD said to me, “Take a large tablet, and write on it with a man’s pen, ‘For Maher Shalal Hash Baz’;
verses.zh: 耶和华对我说：「你取一个大牌，拿人所用的笔（或译：人常用的字），写上『玛黑珥・沙拉勒・哈施・罢斯』（就是掳掠速临、抢夺快到的意思）。

verses.en: and I will take for myself faithful witnesses to testify: Uriah the priest, and Zechariah the son of Jeberechiah.”
verses.zh: 我要用诚实的见证人，祭司乌利亚和耶比利家的儿子撒迦利亚记录这事。」

words.g: Urijah, the name of one Hittite and five Israelites
Zecarjah, the name of twenty-nine Israelites

verses.en: I went to the prophetess, and she conceived, and bore a son. Then the LORD said to me, “Call his name ‘Maher Shalal Hash Baz.’
verses.zh: 我―以赛亚与妻子（原文是女先知）同室；她怀孕生子，耶和华就对我说：「给他起名叫玛黑珥・沙拉勒・哈施・罢斯；

words.g: the + a prophetess or  inspired woman

verses.en: For before the child knows how to say, ‘My father’ and ‘My mother,’ the riches of Damascus and the plunder of Samaria will be carried away by the king of Assyria.”
verses.zh: 因为在这小孩子不晓得叫父叫母之先，大马士革的财宝和撒马利亚的掳物必在亚述王面前搬了去。」

words.g: the + a boy , from the age of infancy to adolescence
father, in a literal and immediate + +me/my
probably a force, whether of men
Ashshur, the second son of Shem

verses.en: The LORD spoke to me yet again, saying,
verses.zh: 耶和华又晓谕我说：

verses.en: “Because this people has refused the waters of Shiloah that go softly, and rejoice in Rezin and Remaliah’s son;
verses.zh: 「这百姓既厌弃西罗亚缓流的水，喜悦利汛和利玛利的儿子；

words.g: the + Shiloach, a fountain of Jerusalem
Retsin, the name of a Syrian and of an Israelite

verses.en: now therefore, behold, the Lord brings upon them the mighty flood waters of the River: the king of Assyria and all his glory. It will come up over all its channels, and go over all its banks.
verses.zh: 因此，主必使大河翻腾的水猛然冲来，就是亚述王和他所有的威势，必漫过一切的水道，涨过两岸；

words.g: Ashshur, the second son of Shem
weight, but only figuratively in a good sense + +him/his/it

verses.en: It will sweep onward into Judah. It will overflow and pass through. It will reach even to the neck. The stretching out of its wings will fill the width of your land, O Immanuel.
verses.zh: 必冲入犹大，涨溢泛滥，直到颈项。以马内利啊，他展开翅膀，遍满你的地。」

words.g: and + to slide by, i.e.  to hasten away
in + Jehudah , the name of five Israelites
Immanuel, a type name of Isaiah's son
Immanuel, a type name of Isaiah's son

verses.en: Make an uproar, you peoples, and be broken in pieces! Listen, all you from far countries: dress for battle, and be shattered! Dress for battle, and be shattered!
verses.zh: 列国的人民哪，任凭你们喧嚷，终必破坏；远方的众人哪，当侧耳而听！任凭你们束起腰来，终必破坏；你们束起腰来，终必破坏。

words.g: and + to broaden out the ear , i.e.  to listen

verses.en: Take counsel together, and it will be brought to nothing; speak the word, and it will not stand, for God is with us.”
verses.zh: 任凭你们同谋，终归无有；任凭你们言定，终不成立；因为神与我们同在。

words.g: and + to break up , i.e. to violate

verses.en: For the LORD spoke this to me with a strong hand, and instructed me not to walk in the way of this people, saying,
verses.zh: 耶和华以大能的手，指教我不可行这百姓所行的道，对我这样说：

words.g: and + to chastise, literally  or figuratively + +me/my

verses.en: “Don’t call a conspiracy all that this people call a conspiracy. Don’t fear their threats or be terrorized.
verses.zh: 「这百姓说同谋背叛，你们不要说同谋背叛。他们所怕的，你们不要怕，也不要畏惧。

verses.en: The LORD of Armies is who you must respect as holy. He is the one you must fear. He is the one you must dread.
verses.zh: 但要尊万军之耶和华为圣，以他为你们所当怕的，所当畏惧的。

words.g: a mass of persons , especially reg. organized forwar

verses.en: He will be a sanctuary, but for both houses of Israel, he will be a stumbling stone and a rock that makes them fall. For the people of Jerusalem, he will be a trap and a snare.
verses.zh: 他必作为圣所，却向以色列两家作绊脚的石头，跌人的磐石；向耶路撒冷的居民作为圈套和网罗。

words.g: to + a consecrated thing or place, especially
Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine

verses.en: Many will stumble over it, fall, be broken, be snared, and be captured.”
verses.zh: 许多人必在其上绊脚跌倒，而且跌碎，并陷入网罗，被缠住。」

verses.en: Wrap up the covenant. Seal the law among my disciples.
verses.zh: 你要卷起律法书，在我门徒中间封住训诲。

verses.en: I will wait for the LORD, who hides his face from the house of Jacob, and I will look for him.
verses.zh: 我要等候那掩面不顾雅各家的耶和华；我也要仰望他。

words.g: the + to hide , literally or figuratively
and + to bind together , i.e. collect

verses.en: Behold, I and the children whom the LORD has given me are for signs and for wonders in Israel from the LORD of Armies, who dwells in Mount Zion.
verses.zh: 看哪，我与耶和华所给我的儿女，就是从住在锡安山万军之耶和华来的，在以色列中作为预兆和奇迹。

words.g: and + the + something born, i.e. a lad or offspring
a mass of persons , especially reg. organized forwar
the + to reside or permanently stay

verses.en: When they tell you, “Consult with those who have familiar spirits and with the wizards, who chirp and who mutter,” shouldn’t a people consult with their God? Should they consult the dead on behalf of the living?
verses.zh: 有人对你们说：「当求问那些交鬼的和行巫术的，就是声音绵蛮，言语微细的。」你们便回答说：「百姓不当求问自己的神吗？岂可为活人求问死人呢？」

words.g: the + a mumble, i.e. a water skin

verses.en: Turn to the law and to the covenant! If they don’t speak according to this word, surely there is no morning for them.
verses.zh: 人当以训诲和法度为标准；他们所说的，若不与此相符，必不得见晨光。

words.g: and + to + attestation, i.e. a precept
used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.en: They will pass through it, very distressed and hungry. It will happen that when they are hungry, they will worry, and curse their king and their God. They will turn their faces upward,
verses.zh: 他们必经过这地，受艰难，受饥饿；饥饿的时候，心中焦躁，咒骂自己的君王和自己的神。

words.g: to be dense, i.e. tough or severe
and + to crack off, i.e.  burst out in rage
to + the upper part, used only adverbially with prefix upward

verses.en: then look to the earth and see distress, darkness, and the gloom of anguish. They will be driven into thick darkness.
verses.zh: 仰观上天，俯察下地，不料，尽是艰难、黑暗，和幽暗的痛苦。他们必被赶入乌黑的黑暗中去。

verses.en: But there shall be no more gloom for her who was in anguish. In the former time, he brought into contempt the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali; but in the latter time he has made it glorious, by the way of the sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the nations.
verses.zh: 但那受过痛苦的必不再见幽暗。从前神使西布伦地和拿弗他利地被藐视，末后却使这沿海的路，约旦河外，外邦人的加利利地得着荣耀。

words.g: the + Jarden, the principal river of Palestine
Galil  in the North of Palestine

verses.en: The people who walked in darkness have seen a great light. The light has shined on those who lived in the land of the shadow of death.
verses.zh: 在黑暗中行走的百姓看见了大光；住在死荫之地的人有光照耀他们。

verses.en: You have multiplied the nation. You have increased their joy. They rejoice before you according to the joy in harvest, as men rejoice when they divide the plunder.
verses.zh: 你使这国民繁多，加增他们的喜乐；他们在你面前欢喜，好像收割的欢喜，像人分掳物那样的快乐。

words.g: to spin round , i.e. usually rejoice

verses.en: For the yoke of his burden, and the staff of his shoulder, the rod of his oppressor, you have broken as in the day of Midian.
verses.zh: 因为他们所负的重轭和肩头上的杖，并欺压他们人的棍，你都已经折断，好像在米甸的日子一样。

words.g: the neck  as the place of burdens + +him/his/it

verses.en: For all the armor of the armed man in the noisy battle, and the garments rolled in blood, will be for burning, fuel for the fire.
verses.zh: 战士在乱杀之间所穿戴的盔甲，并那滚在血中的衣服，都必作为可烧的，当作火柴。

words.g: perhaps a military boot (as aprotection from mud
to shoe, i.e.  a soldier shod
and + a dress, especially a mantle

verses.en: For a child is born to us. A son is given to us; and the government will be on his shoulders. His name will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.
verses.zh: 因有一婴孩为我们而生；有一子赐给我们。政权必担在他的肩头上；他名称为「奇妙策士、全能的神、永在的父、和平的君」。

words.g: something born, i.e. a lad or offspring
the neck  as the place of burdens + +him/his/it
father, in a literal and immediate

verses.en: Of the increase of his government and of peace there shall be no end, on David’s throne, and on his kingdom, to establish it, and to uphold it with justice and with righteousness from that time on, even forever. The zeal of the LORD of Armies will perform this.
verses.zh: 他的政权与平安必加增无穷。他必在大卫的宝座上治理他的国，以公平公义使国坚定稳固，从今直到永远。万军之耶和华的热心必成就这事。

words.g: dominion, i.e.  the estate  or  the country + +him/his/it
a mass of persons , especially reg. organized forwar

verses.en: The Lord sent a word into Jacob, and it falls on Israel.
verses.zh: 主使一言入于雅各家，落于以色列家。

verses.en: All the people will know, including Ephraim and the inhabitants of Samaria, who say in pride and in arrogance of heart,
verses.zh: 这众百姓，就是以法莲和撒马利亚的居民，都要知道；他们凭骄傲自大的心说：

verses.en: “The bricks have fallen, but we will build with cut stone. The sycamore fig trees have been cut down, but we will put cedars in their place.”
verses.zh: 砖墙塌了，我们却要凿石头建筑；桑树砍了，我们却要换香柏树。

words.g: and + something cut, i.e. dressed stone
to slide by, i.e.  to hasten away

verses.en: Therefore the LORD will set up on high against him the adversaries of Rezin, and will stir up his enemies,
verses.zh: 因此，耶和华要高举利汛的敌人来攻击以色列，并要激动以色列的仇敌。

words.g: and + to set on high, protect
Retsin, the name of a Syrian and of an Israelite

verses.en: The Syrians in front, and the Philistines behind; and they will devour Israel with open mouth. For all this, his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
verses.zh: 东有亚兰人，西有非利士人；他们张口要吞吃以色列。虽然如此，耶和华的怒气还未转消；他的手仍伸不缩。

words.g: Aram or Syria, and its inhabitants
and + a Pelishtite or inhabitant of Pelesheth
the mouth , whether literal or figurative

verses.en: Yet the people have not turned to him who struck them, neither have they sought the LORD of Armies.
verses.zh: 这百姓还没有归向击打他们的主，也没有寻求万军之耶和华。

words.g: a mass of persons , especially reg. organized forwar

verses.en: Therefore the LORD will cut off from Israel head and tail, palm branch and reed, in one day.
verses.zh: 因此，耶和华一日之间必从以色列中剪除头与尾，棕枝与芦苇―

verses.en: The elder and the honorable man is the head, and the prophet who teaches lies is the tail.
verses.zh: 长老和尊贵人就是头，以谎言教人的先知就是尾。

words.g: and + a prophet or  inspired man

verses.en: For those who lead this people lead them astray; and those who are led by them are destroyed.
verses.zh: 因为，引导这百姓的使他们走错了路；被引导的都必败亡。

words.g: to vacillate, i.e. reel or stray

verses.en: Therefore the Lord will not rejoice over their young men, neither will he have compassion on their fatherless and widows; for everyone is profane and an evildoer, and every mouth speaks folly. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
verses.zh: 所以，主必不喜悦他们的少年人，也不怜恤他们的孤儿寡妇；因为，各人是亵渎的，是行恶的，并且各人的口都说愚妄的话。虽然如此，耶和华的怒气还未转消；他的手仍伸不缩。

words.g: the mouth , whether literal or figurative

verses.en: For wickedness burns like a fire. It devours the briers and thorns; yes, it kindles in the thickets of the forest, and they roll upward in a column of smoke.
verses.zh: 邪恶像火焚烧，烧灭荆棘和蒺藜，在稠密的树林中着起来，就成为烟柱，旋转上腾。

words.g: and + scrub or trash, i.e. wild growth of weeds or briers
and + to burn or set on fire

verses.en: Through the LORD of Armies’ wrath, the land is burned up; and the people are the fuel for the fire. No one spares his brother.
verses.zh: 因万军之耶和华的烈怒，地都烧遍；百姓成为火柴；无人怜爱弟兄。

words.g: a mass of persons , especially reg. organized forwar
probably to glow, i.e.  be desolated

verses.en: One will devour on the right hand, and be hungry; and he will eat on the left hand, and they will not be satisfied. Everyone will eat the flesh of his own arm:
verses.zh: 有人右边抢夺，仍受饥饿，左边吞吃，仍不饱足；各人吃自己膀臂上的肉。

words.g: and + to cut down or off

verses.en: Manasseh eating Ephraim and Ephraim eating Manasseh, and they together will be against Judah. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
verses.zh: 玛拿西吞吃（或译：攻击；下同）以法莲；以法莲吞吃玛拿西，又一同攻击犹大。虽然如此，耶和华的怒气还未转消；他的手仍伸不缩。

words.g: and + Ephrajim, a son of Joseph
Jehudah , the name of five Israelites

verses.en: Woe to those who decree unrighteous decrees, and to the writers who write oppressive decrees
verses.zh: 祸哉！那些设立不义之律例的和记录奸诈之判语的，

verses.en: to deprive the needy of justice, and to rob the poor among my people of their rights, that widows may be their plunder, and that they may make the fatherless their prey!
verses.zh: 为要屈枉穷乏人，夺去我民中困苦人的理，以寡妇当作掳物，以孤儿当作掠物。

verses.zh: 我怎样待撒马利亚和其中的偶像，岂不照样待耶路撒冷和其中的偶像吗？

verses.en: My hand has found the riches of the peoples like a nest, and like one gathers eggs that are abandoned, I have gathered all the earth. There was no one who moved their wing, or that opened their mouth, or chirped.”
verses.zh: 我的手构到列国的财宝，好像人构到鸟窝；我也得了全地，好像人拾起所弃的雀蛋。没有动翅膀的；没有张嘴的，也没有鸣叫的。

verses.zh: 到那日，以色列所剩下的和雅各家所逃脱的，不再倚靠那击打他们的，却要诚实倚靠耶和华―以色列的圣者。

verses.en: A remnant will return, even the remnant of Jacob, to the mighty God.
verses.zh: 所剩下的，就是雅各家所剩下的，必归回全能的神。

verses.en: For though your people, Israel, are like the sand of the sea, only a remnant of them will return. A destruction is determined, overflowing with righteousness.
verses.zh: 以色列啊，你的百姓虽多如海沙，惟有剩下的归回。原来灭绝的事已定，必有公义施行，如水涨溢。

verses.zh: 万军之耶和华要兴起鞭来攻击他，好像在俄立磐石那里杀戮米甸人一样。耶和华的杖要向海伸出，把杖举起，像在埃及一样。

verses.zh: 那时百姓怎样，祭司也怎样；仆人怎样，主人也怎样；婢女怎样，主母也怎样；买物的怎样，卖物的也怎样；放债的怎样，借债的也怎样；取利的怎样，出利的也怎样。

words.g: like + to twine, i.e.  to unite
like + to twine, i.e.  to unite
like + to lend or  borrow on security or interest

verses.en: The earth will be utterly emptied and utterly laid waste; for the LORD has spoken this word.
verses.zh: 地必全然空虚，尽都荒凉；因为这话是耶和华说的。

words.g: to pour out, i.e. to empty
to pour out, i.e. to empty

verses.en: The earth mourns and fades away. The world languishes and fades away. The lofty people of the earth languish.
verses.zh: 地上悲哀衰残，世界败落衰残；地上居高位的人也败落了。

verses.en: The earth also is polluted under its inhabitants, because they have transgressed the laws, violated the statutes, and broken the everlasting covenant.
verses.zh: 地被其上的居民污秽；因为他们犯了律法，废了律例，背了永约。

words.g: to soil, especially in a moral sense
to slide by, i.e.  to hasten away
to break up , i.e. to violate

verses.en: Therefore the curse has devoured the earth, and those who dwell therein are found guilty. Therefore the inhabitants of the earth are burned, and few men are left.
verses.zh: 所以，地被咒诅吞灭；住在其上的显为有罪。地上的居民被火焚烧，剩下的人稀少。

words.g: to glow, i.e. literally  or figuratively
and + to swell up, i.e. be  redundant

verses.en: The new wine mourns. The vine languishes. All the merry-hearted sigh.
verses.zh: 新酒悲哀，葡萄树衰残；心中欢乐的俱都叹息。

verses.en: The mirth of tambourines ceases. The sound of those who rejoice ends. The joy of the harp ceases.
verses.zh: 击鼓之乐止息；宴乐人的声音完毕，弹琴之乐也止息了。

words.g: to repose, i.e. desist from exertion
to repose, i.e. desist from exertion

verses.en: They will not drink wine with a song. Strong drink will be bitter to those who drink it.
verses.zh: 人必不得饮酒唱歌；喝浓酒的，必以为苦。

words.g: an intoxicant, i.e. intensely alcoholic liquor

verses.en: The confused city is broken down. Every house is shut up, that no man may come in.
verses.zh: 荒凉的城拆毁了；各家关门闭户，使人都不得进去。

verses.en: There is a crying in the streets because of the wine. All joy is darkened. The mirth of the land is gone.
verses.zh: 在街上因酒有悲叹的声音；一切喜乐变为昏暗；地上的欢乐归于无有。

words.g: in + separate by awall, i.e. outside

verses.en: The city is left in desolation, and the gate is struck with destruction.
verses.zh: 城中只有荒凉；城门拆毁净尽。

words.g: to swell up, i.e. be  redundant

verses.en: For it will be so within the earth among the peoples, as the shaking of an olive tree, as the gleanings when the vintage is done.
verses.zh: 在地上的万民中，必像打过的橄榄树，又像已摘的葡萄所剩无几。

words.g: in + the nearest part, i.e. the center
used very widely as demonstrative, lo!
to end, whether intransitive  or transitived

verses.en: These shall lift up their voice. They will shout for the majesty of the LORD. They cry aloud from the sea.
verses.zh: 这些人要高声欢呼；他们为耶和华的威严，从海那里扬起声来。

verses.en: Therefore glorify the LORD in the east, even the name of the LORD, the God of Israel, in the islands of the sea!
verses.zh: 因此，你们要在东方荣耀耶和华，在众海岛荣耀耶和华―以色列神的名。

verses.en: From the uttermost part of the earth have we heard songs. Glory to the righteous! But I said, “I pine away! I pine away! woe is me!” The treacherous have dealt treacherously. Yes, the treacherous have dealt very treacherously.
verses.zh: 我们听见从地极有人歌唱，说：荣耀归于义人。我却说：我消灭了！我消灭了，我有祸了！诡诈的行诡诈；诡诈的大行诡诈。

words.g: a song to be accompanied with instrumental music

verses.en: Fear, the pit, and the snare are on you who inhabit the earth.
verses.zh: 地上的居民哪，恐惧、陷坑、网罗都临近你。

words.g: and + a pit, especially forcatching animals

verses.en: It will happen that he who flees from the noise of the fear will fall into the pit; and he who comes up out of the middle of the pit will be taken in the snare; for the windows on high are opened, and the foundations of the earth tremble.
verses.zh: 躲避恐惧声音的必坠入陷坑；从陷坑上来的必被网罗缠住；因为天上的窗户都开了，地的根基也震动了。

words.g: the + to flit, i.e. vanish away
the + a pit, especially forcatching animals
the + a pit, especially forcatching animals
and + to undulate , particularly through fear

verses.en: The earth is utterly broken. The earth is torn apart. The earth is shaken violently.
verses.zh: 地全然破坏，尽都崩裂，大大地震动了。

words.g: to break up , i.e. to violate
to break up , i.e. to violate

verses.en: The earth will stagger like a drunken man, and will sway back and forth like a hammock. Its disobedience will be heavy on it, and it will fall and not rise again.
verses.zh: 地要东倒西歪，好像醉酒的人；又摇来摇去，好像吊床。罪过在其上沉重，必然塌陷，不能复起。

words.g: to waver, in a great variety of applications
to waver, in a great variety of applications
like + intoxicated, as astate or a habit

verses.en: It will happen in that day that the LORD will punish the army of the high ones on high, and the kings of the earth on the earth.
verses.zh: 到那日，耶和华在高处必惩罚高处的众军，在地上必惩罚地上的列王。

words.g: a mass of persons , especially reg. organized forwar

verses.en: They will be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit, and will be shut up in the prison; and after many days they will be visited.
verses.zh: 他们必被聚集，像囚犯被聚在牢狱中，并要囚在监牢里，多日之后便被讨罪（或译：眷顾）。

words.g: and + to gather for any purpose

verses.en: Then the moon will be confounded, and the sun ashamed; for the LORD of Armies will reign on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem; and glory will be before his elders.
verses.zh: 那时，月亮要蒙羞，日头要惭愧；因为万军之耶和华必在锡安山，在耶路撒冷作王；在敬畏他的长老面前，必有荣耀。

words.g: and + to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed
a mass of persons , especially reg. organized forwar
and + in + Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine
weight, but only figuratively in a good sense

verses.en: The LORD, you are my God. I will exalt you! I will praise your name, for you have done wonderful things, things planned long ago, in complete faithfulness and truth.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，你是我的神；我要尊崇你，我要称赞你的名。因为你以忠信诚实行过奇妙的事，成就你古时所定的。

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you
to be high actively, to rise or raise + +you/your

verses.en: For you have made a city into a heap, a fortified city into a ruin, a palace of strangers to be no city. It will never be built.
verses.zh: 你使城变为乱堆，使坚固城变为荒场，使外邦人宫殿的城不再为城，永远不再建造。

words.g: to + something fallen, i.e. a ruin

verses.en: Therefore a strong people will glorify you. A city of awesome nations will fear you.
verses.zh: 所以，刚强的民必荣耀你；强暴之国的城必敬畏你。

verses.en: For you have been a stronghold to the poor, a stronghold to the needy in his distress, a refuge from the storm, a shade from the heat, when the blast of the dreaded ones is like a storm against the wall.
verses.zh: 因为当强暴人催逼人的时候，如同暴风直吹墙壁，你就作贫穷人的保障，作困乏人急难中的保障，作躲暴风之处，作避炎热的阴凉。

words.g: to + dangling, i.e.  weak or thin

verses.en: As the heat in a dry place you will bring down the noise of strangers; as the heat by the shade of a cloud, the song of the dreaded ones will be brought low.
verses.zh: 你要压制外邦人的喧哗，好像干燥地的热气下落；禁止强暴人的凯歌，好像热气被云影消化。

words.g: a song to be accompanied with instrumental music

verses.en: In this mountain, the LORD of Armies will make all peoples a feast of choice meat, a feast of choice wines, of choice meat full of marrow, of well refined choice wines.
verses.zh: 在这山上，万军之耶和华必为万民用肥甘设摆筵席，用陈酒和满髓的肥甘，并澄清的陈酒，设摆筵席。

words.g: a mass of persons , especially reg. organized forwar
something preserved, i.e. the settlings  of wine
something preserved, i.e. the settlings  of wine

verses.en: He will destroy in this mountain the surface of the covering that covers all peoples, and the veil that is spread over all nations.
verses.zh: 他又必在这山上除灭遮盖万民之物和遮蔽万国蒙脸的帕子。

words.g: and + the + a pouring over, i.e. fusion of metal
the + to interweave, i.e.  to overspread

verses.en: He has swallowed up death forever! The Lord GOD will wipe away tears from off all faces. He will take the reproach of his people away from off all the earth, for the LORD has spoken it.
verses.zh: 他已经吞灭死亡直到永远。主耶和华必擦去各人脸上的眼泪，又除掉普天下他百姓的羞辱，因为这是耶和华说的。

words.g: to + a goal, i.e. the bright object at adistance travelled towards

verses.en: It shall be said in that day, “Behold, this is our God! We have waited for him, and he will save us! This is the LORD! We have waited for him. We will be glad and rejoice in his salvation!”
verses.zh: 到那日，人必说：「看哪，这是我们的神；我们素来等候他，他必拯救我们。这是耶和华，我们素来等候他，我们必因他的救恩欢喜快乐。」

words.g: and + to be open, wide or free + +us/our
to spin round , i.e. usually rejoice

verses.en: For the LORD’s hand will rest in this mountain. Moab will be trodden down in his place, even like straw is trodden down in the water of the dunghill.
verses.zh: 耶和华的手必按在这山上；摩押人在所居之地必被践踏，好像干草被践踏在粪池的水中。

words.g: Moab, an incestuous son of Lot

verses.en: He will spread out his hands in the middle of it, like one who swims spreads out hands to swim, but his pride will be humbled together with the craft of his hands.
verses.zh: 他必在其中伸开手，好像洑水的伸开手洑水一样；但耶和华必使他的骄傲和他手所行的诡计一并败落。

words.g: in + the nearest part, i.e. the center + +him/his/it

verses.en: He has brought the high fortress of your walls down, laid low, and brought to the ground, even to the dust.
verses.zh: 耶和华使你城上的坚固高台倾倒，拆平，直到尘埃。

verses.en: In that day, this song will be sung in the land of Judah: “We have a strong city. God appoints salvation for walls and bulwarks.
verses.zh: 当那日，在犹大地人必唱这歌说：我们有坚固的城。耶和华要将救恩定为城墙，为外郭。

words.g: Jehudah , the name of five Israelites

verses.en: Open the gates, that the righteous nation may enter: the one which keeps faith.
verses.zh: 敞开城门，使守信的义民得以进入。

verses.en: You will keep whoever’s mind is steadfast in perfect peace, because he trusts in you.
verses.zh: 坚心倚赖你的，你必保守他十分平安，因为他倚靠你。

words.g: to guard, in a good sense  or a bad one

verses.en: Trust in the LORD forever; for in the LORD, the LORD, is an everlasting Rock.
verses.zh: 你们当倚靠耶和华直到永远，因为耶和华是永久的磐石。

verses.en: For he has brought down those who dwell on high, the lofty city. He lays it low. He lays it low even to the ground. He brings it even to the dust.
verses.zh: 他使住高处的与高城一并败落，将城拆毁，拆平，直到尘埃，

verses.en: The foot shall tread it down, even the feet of the poor and the steps of the needy.”
verses.zh: 要被脚践踏，就是被困苦人的脚和穷乏人的脚践踏。

verses.en: The way of the just is uprightness. You who are upright make the path of the righteous level.
verses.zh: 义人的道是正直的；你为正直的主，必修平义人的路。

verses.en: Yes, in the way of your judgments, LORD, we have waited for you. Your name and your renown are the desire of our soul.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，我们在你行审判的路上等候你；我们心里所羡慕的是你的名，就是你那可记念的名。

words.g: and + to + a memento, abstractly recollection + +you/your

verses.en: With my soul I have desired you in the night. Yes, with my spirit within me I will seek you earnestly; for when your judgments are on the earth, the inhabitants of the world learn righteousness.
verses.zh: 夜间，我心中羡慕你；我里面的灵切切寻求你。因为你在世上行审判的时候，地上的居民就学习公义。

words.g: in + the nearest part, i.e. the center + +me/my
to dawn, i.e.  be  early at any task + +you/your

verses.en: Let favor be shown to the wicked, yet he will not learn righteousness. In the land of uprightness he will deal wrongfully, and will not see the LORD’s majesty.
verses.zh: 以恩惠待恶人，他仍不学习公义；在正直的地上，他必行事不义，也不注意耶和华的威严。

verses.en: LORD, your hand is lifted up, yet they don’t see; but they will see your zeal for the people and be disappointed. Yes, fire will consume your adversaries.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，你的手高举，他们仍然不看；却要看你为百姓发的热心，因而抱愧，并且有火烧灭你的敌人。

words.g: to be high actively, to rise or raise
and + to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed

verses.en: LORD, you will ordain peace for us, for you have also done all our work for us.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，你必派定我们得平安，因为我们所做的事都是你给我们成就的。

words.g: to locate, i.e.  hang on or  establish
to do or make , especially to practise

verses.en: LORD our God, other lords besides you have had dominion over us, but we will only acknowledge your name.
verses.zh: 耶和华―我们的神啊，在你以外曾有别的主管辖我们，但我们专要倚靠你，提你的名。

verses.en: The dead shall not live. The departed spirits shall not rise. Therefore you have visited and destroyed them, and caused all memory of them to perish.
verses.zh: 他们死了，必不能再活；他们去世，必不能再起；因为你刑罚他们，毁灭他们，他们的名号就全然消灭。

words.g: to live, whether literally or figuratively

verses.en: You have increased the nation, O LORD. You have increased the nation! You are glorified! You have enlarged all the borders of the land.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，你增添国民，你增添国民；你得了荣耀，又扩张地的四境。

words.g: to widen , i.e.  recede or  remove

verses.en: LORD, in trouble they have visited you. They poured out a prayer when your chastening was on them.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，他们在急难中寻求你；你的惩罚临到他们身上，他们就倾心吐胆祷告你。

verses.en: Just as a woman with child, who draws near the time of her delivery, is in pain and cries out in her pangs, so we have been before you, LORD.
verses.zh: 妇人怀孕，临产疼痛，在痛苦之中喊叫；耶和华啊，我们在你面前也是如此。

words.g: a form of the prefix 'k-', but used separately  as
to twist or whirl , i.e.  to dance
in + a rope , especially a measuring line + +her/its

verses.en: We have been with child. We have been in pain. We gave birth, it seems, only to wind. We have not worked any deliverance on the earth; neither have the inhabitants of the world fallen.
verses.zh: 我们也曾怀孕疼痛，所产的竟像风一样。我们在地上未曾行甚么拯救的事；世上的居民也未曾败落。

words.g: to twist or whirl , i.e.  to dance
a form of the prefix 'k-', but used separately  as

verses.en: Your dead shall live. Their dead bodies shall arise. Awake and sing, you who dwell in the dust; for your dew is like the dew of herbs, and the earth will cast out the departed spirits.
verses.zh: 死人（原文是你的死人）要复活，尸首（原文是我的尸首）要兴起。睡在尘埃的啊，要醒起歌唱！因你的甘露好像菜蔬上的甘露，地也要交出死人来。

words.g: to live, whether literally or figuratively
a flabby thing, i.e. a carcase or carrion + +me/my
and + to creak , i.e. to shout

verses.en: Come, my people, enter into your rooms, and shut your doors behind you. Hide yourself for a little moment, until the indignation is past.
verses.zh: 我的百姓啊，你们要来进入内室，关上门，隐藏片时，等到忿怒过去。

words.g: something swinging, i.e. the valve of adoor + +you/your
a wink , i.e. a very short space of time
strictly froth at the mouth, i.e.  fury

verses.en: For, behold, the LORD comes out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity. The earth also will disclose her blood, and will no longer cover her slain.
verses.zh: 因为耶和华从他的居所出来，要刑罚地上居民的罪孽。地也必露出其中的血，不再掩盖被杀的人。

verses.en: In that day, the LORD with his hard and great and strong sword will punish leviathan, the fleeing serpent, and leviathan, the twisted serpent; and he will kill the dragon that is in the sea.
verses.zh: 到那日，耶和华必用他刚硬有力的大刀刑罚鳄鱼―就是那快行的蛇，刑罚鳄鱼―就是那曲行的蛇，并杀海中的大鱼。

words.g: a wreathed animal, i.e. a serpent
a wreathed animal, i.e. a serpent
and + to smite with deadly intent
the + a marine or land monster, i.e. sea-serpent or jackal

verses.en: In that day, sing to her, “A pleasant vineyard!
verses.zh: 当那日，有出酒的葡萄园，你们要指这园唱歌说：

verses.en: I, the LORD, am its keeper. I will water it every moment. Lest anyone damage it, I will keep it night and day.
verses.zh: 我―耶和华是看守葡萄园的；我必时刻浇灌，昼夜看守，免得有人损害。

words.g: to guard, in a good sense  or a bad one + +her/its
to + a wink , i.e. a very short space of time
to quaff, i.e.  to irrigate or furnish apotion to + +her/its

verses.en: Wrath is not in me, but if I should find briers and thorns, I would do battle! I would march on them and I would burn them together.
verses.zh: 我心中不存忿怒。惟愿荆棘蒺藜与我交战，我就勇往直前，把它一同焚烧。

words.g: scrub or trash, i.e. wild growth of weeds or briers

verses.en: Or else let him take hold of my strength, that he may make peace with me. Let him make peace with me.”
verses.zh: 不然，让它持住我的能力，使它与我和好，愿它与我和好。

verses.en: In days to come, Jacob will take root. Israel will blossom and bud. They will fill the surface of the world with fruit.
verses.zh: 将来雅各要扎根，以色列要发芽开花；他们的果实必充满世界。

words.g: to root, i.e. strike into the soil
and + to break forth as a bud, i.e. bloom

verses.en: Has he struck them as he struck those who struck them? Or are they killed like those who killed them were killed?
verses.zh: 主击打他们，岂像击打那些击打他们的人吗？他们被杀戮，岂像被他们所杀戮的吗？

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.en: In measure, when you send them away, you contend with them. He has removed them with his rough blast in the day of the east wind.
verses.zh: 你打发他们去，是相机宜与他们相争；刮东风的日子，就用暴风将他们逐去。

verses.en: Therefore by this the iniquity of Jacob will be forgiven, and this is all the fruit of taking away his sin: that he makes all the stones of the altar as chalk stones that are beaten in pieces, so that the Asherah poles and the incense altars shall rise no more.
verses.zh: 所以，雅各的罪孽得赦免，他的罪过得除掉的果效，全在乎此：就是他叫祭坛的石头变为打碎的灰石，以致木偶和日像不再立起。

words.g: to dash to pieces, or scatter

verses.en: For the fortified city is solitary, a habitation deserted and forsaken, like the wilderness. The calf will feed there, and there he will lie down, and consume its branches.
verses.zh: 因为坚固城变为凄凉，成了撇下离弃的居所，像旷野一样；牛犊必在那里吃草，在那里躺卧，并吃尽其中的树枝。

words.g: a  calf , especially one nearly grown
and + to end, whether intransitive  or transitived

verses.en: When its boughs are withered, they will be broken off. The women will come and set them on fire, for they are a people of no understanding. Therefore he who made them will not have compassion on them, and he who formed them will show them no favor.
verses.zh: 枝条枯干，必被折断；妇女要来点火烧着。因为这百姓蒙昧无知，所以，创造他们的必不怜恤他们；造成他们的也不施恩与他们。

words.g: and + to mould into a form + +him/his/it

verses.en: It will happen in that day that the LORD will thresh from the flowing stream of the Euphrates to the brook of Egypt; and you will be gathered one by one, children of Israel.
verses.zh: 以色列人哪，到那日，耶和华必从大河，直到埃及小河，将你们一一地收集，如同人打树拾果一样。

words.g: a stream, especially a winter torrent
Mitsrajim, i.e. Upper and Lower Egypt
and + thou and thee, or  ye and you
to pick up, i.e.  to gather

verses.zh: 当那日，必大发角声，在亚述地将要灭亡的，并在埃及地被赶散的，都要来，他们就在耶路撒冷圣山上敬拜耶和华。

words.g: in + a cornet  or curved horn
Ashshur, the second son of Shem
Mitsrajim, i.e. Upper and Lower Egypt
in + Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine

verses.en: Woe to the crown of pride of the drunkards of Ephraim, and to the fading flower of his glorious beauty, which is on the head of the fertile valley of those who are overcome with wine!
verses.zh: 祸哉！以法莲的酒徒，住在肥美谷的山上，他们心里高傲，以所夸的为冠冕，犹如将残之花。

words.g: intoxicated, as astate or a habit
and + glistening, i.e. a burnished plate

verses.en: Behold, the Lord has one who is mighty and strong. Like a storm of hail, a destroying storm, and like a storm of mighty waters overflowing, he will cast them down to the earth with his hand.
verses.zh: 看哪，主有一大能大力者，像一阵冰雹，像毁灭的暴风，像涨溢的大水，他必用手将冠冕摔落于地。

verses.en: The crown of pride of the drunkards of Ephraim will be trodden under foot.
verses.zh: 以法莲高傲的酒徒，他的冠冕必被踏在脚下。

words.g: intoxicated, as astate or a habit

verses.en: The fading flower of his glorious beauty, which is on the head of the fertile valley, shall be like the first-ripe fig before the summer, which someone picks and eats as soon as he sees it.
verses.zh: 那荣美将残之花，就是在肥美谷山上的，必像夏令以前初熟的无花果；看见这果的就注意，一到手中就吞吃了。

words.g: like + the first-fruits of the crop
harvest , whether the product  or the  season

verses.en: In that day, the LORD of Armies will become a crown of glory and a diadem of beauty to the residue of his people,
verses.zh: 到那日，万军之耶和华必作他余剩之民的荣冠华冕，

words.g: a mass of persons , especially reg. organized forwar

verses.zh: 也作了在位上行审判者公平之灵，并城门口打退仇敌者的力量。

verses.en: They also reel with wine, and stagger with strong drink. The priest and the prophet reel with strong drink. They are swallowed up by wine. They stagger with strong drink. They err in vision. They stumble in judgment.
verses.zh: 就是这地的人也因酒摇摇晃晃，因浓酒东倒西歪。祭司和先知因浓酒摇摇晃晃，被酒所困，因浓酒东倒西歪。他们错解默示，谬行审判。

to vacillate, i.e. reel or stray

in + an intoxicant, i.e. intensely alcoholic liquor
to vacillate, i.e. reel or stray
the + an intoxicant, i.e. intensely alcoholic liquor

verses.en: For all tables are completely full of filthy vomit and filthiness.
verses.zh: 因为各席上满了呕吐的污秽，无一处干净。

verses.en: Whom will he teach knowledge? To whom will he explain the message? Those who are weaned from the milk, and drawn from the breasts?
verses.zh: 讥诮先知的说：他要将知识指教谁呢？要使谁明白传言呢？是那刚断奶离怀的吗？

words.g: to treat a person , i.e. benefit or requite
from + the breast of a woman or animal

verses.en: For it is precept on precept, precept on precept; line on line, line on line; here a little, there a little.
verses.zh: 他竟命上加命，令上加令，律上加律，例上加例，这里一点，那里一点。

verses.en: But he will speak to this nation with stammering lips and in another language,
verses.zh: 先知说：不然，主要藉异邦人的嘴唇和外邦人的舌头对这百姓说话。

words.g: and + in + the tongue , used literally

verses.en: to whom he said, “This is the resting place. Give rest to the weary,” and “This is the refreshing;” yet they would not hear.
verses.zh: 他曾对他们说：你们要使疲乏人得安息，这样才得安息，才得舒畅，他们却不肯听。

words.g: to breathe after, i.e.  to be acquiescent

verses.en: Therefore the LORD’s word will be to them precept on precept, precept on precept; line on line, line on line; here a little, there a little; that they may go, fall backward, be broken, be snared, and be taken.
verses.zh: 所以，耶和华向他们说的话是命上加命，令上加令，律上加律，例上加例，这里一点，那里一点，以致他们前行仰面跌倒，而且跌碎，并陷入网罗被缠住。

verses.en: Therefore hear the LORD’s word, you scoffers, that rule this people in Jerusalem:
verses.zh: 所以，你们这些亵慢的人，就是辖管住在耶路撒冷这百姓的，要听耶和华的话。

words.g: in + Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine

verses.en: “Because you have said, ‘We have made a covenant with death, and we are in agreement with Sheol. When the overflowing scourge passes through, it won’t come to us; for we have made lies our refuge, and we have hidden ourselves under falsehood.’”
verses.zh: 你们曾说：我们与死亡立约，与阴间结盟；敌军（原文是鞭子）如水涨漫经过的时候，必不临到我们；因我们以谎言为避所，在虚假以下藏身。

verses.en: Therefore the Lord GOD says, “Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a tried stone, a precious cornerstone of a sure foundation. He who believes shall not act hastily.
verses.zh: 所以，主耶和华如此说：看哪，我在锡安放一块石头作为根基，是试验过的石头，是稳固根基，宝贵的房角石；信靠的人必不着急。

words.g: in + Tsijon , a mountain of Jerusalem

verses.en: I will make justice the measuring line, and righteousness the plumb line. The hail will sweep away the refuge of lies, and the waters will overflow the hiding place.
verses.zh: 我必以公平为准绳，以公义为线铊。冰雹必冲去谎言的避所；大水必漫过藏身之处。

words.g: to + a weight, i.e. a plummet

verses.en: Your covenant with death shall be annulled, and your agreement with Sheol shall not stand. When the overflowing scourge passes through, then you will be trampled down by it.
verses.zh: 你们与死亡所立的约必然废掉，与阴间所结的盟必立不住。敌军（原文是鞭子）如水涨漫经过的时候，你们必被他践踏；

verses.en: As often as it passes through, it will seize you; for morning by morning it will pass through, by day and by night; and it will be nothing but terror to understand the message.”
verses.zh: 每逢经过必将你们掳去。因为每早晨他必经过，白昼黑夜都必如此。明白传言的必受惊恐。

words.g: from + enough , used chiefly with preposition in phrases

verses.en: For the bed is too short to stretch out on, and the blanket is too narrow to wrap oneself in.
verses.zh: 原来，床榻短，使人不能舒身；被窝窄，使人不能遮体。

words.g: from + to prolong, i.e.  be deformed by excess of members
and + the + a pouring over, i.e. fusion of metal

verses.zh: 耶和华必兴起，像在毗拉心山；他必发怒，像在基遍谷，好做成他的工，就是非常的工；成就他的事，就是奇异的事。

words.g: in + Gibon, a place in Palestine
strange, in a variety of degrees and applications

verses.zh: 现在你们不可亵慢，恐怕捆你们的绑索更结实了；因为我从主―万军之耶和华那里听见，已经决定在全地上施行灭绝的事。

words.g: and + to point sharply, i.e.  to wound
a mass of persons , especially reg. organized forwar

words.g: to broaden out the ear , i.e.  to listen
to prick up the ears, i.e. hearken

verses.en: Does he who plows to sow plow continually? Does he keep turning the soil and breaking the clods?
verses.zh: 那耕地为要撒种的，岂是常常耕地呢？岂是常常开垦耙地呢？

words.g: the + to scratch, i.e.  to engrave
and + to abrade, i.e. harrow afield

verses.en: When he has leveled its surface, doesn’t he plant the dill, and scatter the cumin seed, and put in the wheat in rows, the barley in the appointed place, and the spelt in its place?
verses.zh: 他拉平了地面，岂不就撒种小茴香，播种大茴香，按行列种小麦，在定处种大麦，在田边种粗麦呢？

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!
and + to dash in pieces, literally or figuratively
wheat, whether the grain or the plant

verses.en: For his God instructs him in right judgment and teaches him.
verses.zh: 因为他的神教导他务农相宜，并且指教他。

words.g: and + to chastise, literally  or figuratively + +him/his/it

verses.zh: 原来打小茴香，不用尖利的器具，轧大茴香，也不用碌碡（原文是车轮；下同）；但用杖打小茴香，用棍打大茴香。

words.g: something revolving, i.e. a wheeled vehicle

verses.zh: 做饼的粮食是用磨磨碎，因它不必常打；虽用碌碡和马打散，却不磨它。

words.g: to + a goal, i.e. the bright object at adistance travelled towards
something revolving, i.e. a wheeled vehicle + +him/his/it

verses.zh: 这也是出于万军之耶和华―他的谋略奇妙；他的智慧广大。

words.g: a mass of persons , especially reg. organized forwar

verses.zh: 唉！亚利伊勒，亚利伊勒，大卫安营的城，任凭你年上加年，节期照常周流。

Ariel, a symbolical name for Jerusalem

to strike with more or less violence

verses.zh: 我终必使亚利伊勒困难；她必悲伤哀号，我却仍以她为亚利伊勒。

words.g: to + Ariel, a symbolical name for Jerusalem
like + Ariel, a symbolical name for Jerusalem

verses.zh: 我必四围安营攻击你，屯兵围困你，筑垒攻击你。

verses.zh: 你必败落，从地中说话；你的言语必微细出于尘埃。你的声音必像那交鬼者的声音出于地；你的言语低低微微出于尘埃。

words.g: like + a mumble, i.e. a water skin

verses.zh: 万军之耶和华必用雷轰、地震、大声、旋风、暴风，并吞灭的火焰，向她讨罪。

words.g: a mass of persons , especially reg. organized forwar

verses.zh: 那时，攻击亚利伊勒列国的群众，就是一切攻击亚利伊勒和她的保障，并使她困难的，必如梦景，如夜间的异象；

words.g: Ariel, a symbolical name for Jerusalem
and + the + to compress, i.e.  oppress

verses.en: It will be like when a hungry man dreams, and behold, he eats; but he awakes, and his hunger isn’t satisfied; or like when a thirsty man dreams, and behold, he drinks; but he awakes, and behold, he is faint, and he is still thirsty. The multitude of all the nations that fight against Mount Zion will be like that.
verses.zh: 又必像饥饿的人梦中吃饭，醒了仍觉腹空；或像口渴的人梦中喝水，醒了仍觉发昏，心里想喝。攻击锡安山列国的群众也必如此。

words.g: to bind firmly, i.e.  to be  plump
to bind firmly, i.e.  to be  plump

verses.zh: 你们等候惊奇吧！你们宴乐昏迷吧！他们醉了，却非因酒；他们东倒西歪，却非因浓酒。

and + to look upon , i.e. fondle
to waver, in a great variety of applications

verses.zh: 因为耶和华将沉睡的灵浇灌你们，封闭你们的眼，蒙盖你们的头。你们的眼就是先知；你们的头就是先见。

words.g: to pour out, especially a libation
and + to bind fast, i.e. close
the + a prophet or  inspired man

verses.zh: 所有的默示，你们看如封住的书卷，人将这书卷交给识字的，说：「请念吧！」他说：「我不能念，因为是封住了。」

verses.en: and the book is delivered to one who is not educated, saying, “Read this, please;” and he says, “I can’t read.”
verses.zh: 又将这书卷交给不识字的人，说：「请念吧！」他说：「我不识字。」

verses.en: The Lord said, “Because this people draws near with their mouth and honors me with their lips, but they have removed their heart far from me, and their fear of me is a commandment of men which has been taught;
verses.zh: 主说：因为这百姓亲近我，用嘴唇尊敬我，心却远离我；他们敬畏我，不过是领受人的吩咐。

words.g: in + the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +him/his/it
to widen , i.e.  recede or  remove
a command, whether human or divine

verses.zh: 所以，我在这百姓中要行奇妙的事，就是奇妙又奇妙的事。他们智慧人的智慧必然消灭，聪明人的聪明必然隐藏。

words.g: to + perhaps to separate, i.e. distinguish

verses.en: Woe to those who deeply hide their counsel from the LORD, and whose deeds are in the dark, and who say, “Who sees us?” and “Who knows us?”
verses.zh: 祸哉！那些向耶和华深藏谋略的，又在暗中行事，说：谁看见我们呢？谁知道我们呢？

words.g: to + to hide , literally or figuratively

verses.zh: 你们把事颠倒了，岂可看窑匠如泥吗？被制作的物岂可论制作物的说：他没有制作我？或是被创造的物论造物的说：他没有聪明？

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!
like + a bubbling up, i.e. of water
the + to mould into a form
to + to mould into a form + +him/his/it

verses.zh: 黎巴嫩变为肥田，肥田看如树林，不是只有一点点时候吗？

verses.zh: 那时，聋子必听见这书上的话；瞎子的眼必从迷蒙黑暗中得以看见。

verses.zh: 谦卑人必因耶和华增添欢喜；人间贫穷的必因以色列的圣者快乐。

verses.zh: 因为，强暴人已归无有，亵慢人已经灭绝，一切找机会作孽的都被剪除。

words.g: and + to end, whether intransitive  or transitived

verses.en: who cause a person to be indicted by a word, and lay a snare for one who reproves in the gate, and who deprive the innocent of justice with false testimony.
verses.zh: 他们在争讼的事上定无罪的为有罪，为城门口责备人的设下网罗，用虚无的事屈枉义人。

words.g: and + to stretch or spread out

verses.zh: 但他看见他的众子，就是我手的工作在他那里，他们必尊我的名为圣，必尊雅各的圣者为圣，必敬畏以色列的神。

words.g: something born, i.e. a lad or offspring + +him/his/it

verses.zh: 耶和华说：祸哉！这悖逆的儿女。他们同谋，却不由于我，结盟，却不由于我的灵，以致罪上加罪；

verses.zh: 所以，法老的力量必作你们的羞辱；投在埃及的荫下，要为你们的惭愧。

verses.zh: 论南方牲畜的默示：他们把财物驮在驴驹的脊背上，将宝物驮在骆驼的肉鞍上，经过艰难困苦之地，就是公狮、母狮、蝮蛇、火焰的飞龙之地，往那不利于他们的民那里去。

verses.zh: 现今你去，在他们面前将这话刻在版上，写在书上，以便传留后世，直到永永远远。

verses.en: For it is a rebellious people, lying children, children who will not hear the LORD’s law;
verses.zh: 因为他们是悖逆的百姓、说谎的儿女，不肯听从耶和华训诲的儿女。

words.g: to breathe after, i.e.  to be acquiescent

verses.en: who tell the seers, “Don’t see!” and the prophets, “Don’t prophesy to us right things. Tell us pleasant things. Prophesy deceits.
verses.zh: 他们对先见说：不要望见不吉利的事，对先知说：不要向我们讲正直的话；要向我们说柔和的话，言虚幻的事。

words.g: and + to + a beholder in vision

verses.en: Get out of the way. Turn away from the path. Cause the Holy One of Israel to cease from before us.”
verses.zh: 你们要离弃正道，偏离直路，不要在我们面前再提说以色列的圣者。

words.g: to repose, i.e. desist from exertion

verses.en: Therefore the Holy One of Israel says, “Because you despise this word, and trust in oppression and perverseness, and rely on it,
verses.zh: 所以，以色列的圣者如此说：因为你们藐视这训诲的话，倚赖欺压和乖僻，以此为可靠的，

words.g: and + to turn aside , i.e.  to depart

verses.en: therefore this iniquity shall be to you like a breach ready to fall, swelling out in a high wall, whose breaking comes suddenly in an instant.
verses.zh: 故此，这罪孽在你们身上，好像将要破裂凸出来的高墙，顷刻之间忽然坍塌；

words.g: to gush over, i.e. to swell
to + a wink, i.e. moment adverbially

verses.en: He will break it as a potter’s vessel is broken, breaking it in pieces without sparing, so that there won’t be found among the broken pieces a piece good enough to take fire from the hearth, or to dip up water out of the cistern.”
verses.zh: 要被打碎，好像把窑匠的瓦器打碎，毫不顾惜，甚至碎块中找不到一片可用以从炉内取火，从池中舀水。

words.g: and + to + to strip off, i.e. generally to make naked

verses.en: For thus said the Lord GOD, the Holy One of Israel, “You will be saved in returning and rest. Your strength will be in quietness and in confidence.” You refused,
verses.zh: 主耶和华―以色列的圣者曾如此说：你们得救在乎归回安息；你们得力在乎平静安稳；你们竟自不肯。

words.g: to be open, wide or free
to breathe after, i.e.  to be acquiescent

verses.en: but you said, “No, for we will flee on horses;” therefore you will flee; and, “We will ride on the swift;” therefore those who pursue you will be swift.
verses.zh: 你们却说：不然，我们要骑马奔走。所以你们必然奔走；又说：我们要骑飞快的牲口。所以追赶你们的，也必飞快。

verses.en: One thousand will flee at the threat of one. At the threat of five, you will flee until you are left like a beacon on the top of a mountain, and like a banner on a hill.
verses.zh: 一人叱喝，必令千人逃跑；五人叱喝，你们都必逃跑；以致剩下的，好像山顶的旗杆，冈上的大旗。

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.en: Therefore the LORD will wait, that he may be gracious to you; and therefore he will be exalted, that he may have mercy on you, for the LORD is a God of justice. Blessed are all those who wait for him.
verses.zh: 耶和华必然等候，要施恩给你们；必然兴起，好怜悯你们。因为耶和华是公平的神；凡等候他的都是有福的！

words.g: to be high actively, to rise or raise

verses.en: For the people will dwell in Zion at Jerusalem. You will weep no more. He will surely be gracious to you at the voice of your cry. When he hears you, he will answer you.
verses.zh: 百姓必在锡安、在耶路撒冷居住；你不再哭泣。主必因你哀求的声音施恩给你；他听见的时候就必应允你。

words.g: in + Tsijon , a mountain of Jerusalem
in + Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine

verses.en: Though the Lord may give you the bread of adversity and the water of affliction, yet your teachers won’t be hidden any more, but your eyes will see your teachers;
verses.zh: 主虽然以艰难给你当饼，以困苦给你当水，你的教师却不再隐藏；你眼必看见你的教师。

words.g: to project laterally, i.e. probably  to withdraw

verses.en: and when you turn to the right hand, and when you turn to the left, your ears will hear a voice behind you, saying, “This is the way. Walk in it.”
verses.zh: 你或向左或向右，你必听见后边有声音说：「这是正路，要行在其间。」

words.g: to take the right hand road
to use the left hand or pass in that direction)

verses.en: You shall defile the overlaying of your engraved images of silver, and the plating of your molten images of gold. You shall cast them away as an unclean thing. You shall tell it, “Go away!”
verses.zh: 你雕刻偶像所包的银子和铸造偶像所镀的金子，你要玷污，要抛弃，好像污秽之物，对偶像说：「去吧！」

words.g: and + to be foul, especially in a ceremial or moral sense
a pouring over, i.e. fusion of metal
a form of the prefix 'k-', but used separately  as

verses.en: He will give the rain for your seed, with which you will sow the ground; and bread of the increase of the ground will be rich and plentiful. In that day, your livestock will feed in large pastures.
verses.zh: 你将种子撒在地里，主必降雨在其上，并使地所出的粮肥美丰盛。到那时，你的牲畜必在宽阔的草场吃草。

verses.en: The oxen likewise and the young donkeys that till the ground will eat savory feed, which has been winnowed with the shovel and with the fork.
verses.zh: 耕地的牛和驴驹必吃加盐的料；这料是用木杴和杈子扬净的。

verses.en: There will be brooks and streams of water on every lofty mountain and on every high hill in the day of the great slaughter, when the towers fall.
verses.zh: 在大行杀戮的日子，高台倒塌的时候，各高山冈陵必有川流河涌。

verses.en: Moreover the light of the moon will be like the light of the sun, and the light of the sun will be seven times brighter, like the light of seven days, in the day that the LORD binds up the fracture of his people, and heals the wound they were struck with.
verses.zh: 当耶和华缠裹他百姓的损处，医治他民鞭伤的日子，月光必像日光，日光必加七倍，像七日的光一样。

verses.en: Behold, the LORD’s name comes from far away, burning with his anger, and in thick rising smoke. His lips are full of indignation. His tongue is as a devouring fire.
verses.zh: 看哪，耶和华的名从远方来，怒气烧起，密烟上腾。他的嘴唇满有忿恨；他的舌头像吞灭的火。

words.g: from + remoteness, i.e.  a distant place
strictly froth at the mouth, i.e.  fury

verses.en: His breath is as an overflowing stream that reaches even to the neck, to sift the nations with the sieve of destruction. A bridle that leads to ruin will be in the jaws of the peoples.
verses.zh: 他的气如涨溢的河水，直涨到颈项，要用毁灭的筛箩筛净列国，并且在众民的口中必有使人错行的嚼环。

words.g: like + a stream, especially a winter torrent
to cut or split in two
to vacillate, i.e. reel or stray

verses.en: You will have a song, as in the night when a holy feast is kept, and gladness of heart, as when one goes with a flute to come to the LORD’s mountain, to Israel’s Rock.
verses.zh: 你们必唱歌，像守圣节的夜间一样，并且心中喜乐，像人吹笛，上耶和华的山，到以色列的磐石那里。

words.g: a festival, or a victim therefor

verses.en: The LORD will cause his glorious voice to be heard, and will show the descent of his arm, with the indignation of his anger and the flame of a devouring fire, with a blast, storm, and hailstones.
verses.zh: 耶和华必使人听他威严的声音，又显他降罚的膀臂和他怒中的忿恨，并吞灭的火焰与霹雷、暴风、冰雹。

verses.en: For through the LORD’s voice the Assyrian will be dismayed. He will strike him with his rod.
verses.zh: 亚述人必因耶和华的声音惊惶；耶和华必用杖击打他。

words.g: Ashshur, the second son of Shem

verses.en: Every stroke of the rod of punishment, which the LORD will lay on him, will be with the sound of tambourines and harps. He will fight with them in battles, brandishing weapons.
verses.zh: 耶和华必将命定的杖加在他身上；每打一下，人必击鼓弹琴。打仗的时候，耶和华必抡起手来，与他交战。

verses.en: For his burning place has long been ready. Yes, it is prepared for the king. He has made its pyre deep and large with fire and much wood. The LORD’s breath, like a stream of sulfur, kindles it.
verses.zh: 原来陀斐特又深又宽，早已为王预备好了；其中堆的是火与许多木柴。耶和华的气如一股硫磺火使他着起来。

words.g: to set in a row, i.e. arrange
like + a stream, especially a winter torrent

verses.en: Woe to those who go down to Egypt for help, and rely on horses, and trust in chariots because they are many, and in horsemen because they are very strong, but they don’t look to the Holy One of Israel, and they don’t seek the LORD!
verses.zh: 祸哉！那些下埃及求帮助的，是因仗赖马匹，倚靠甚多的车辆，并倚靠强壮的马兵，却不仰望以色列的圣者，也不求问耶和华。

words.g: Mitsrajim, i.e. Upper and Lower Egypt

verses.en: Yet he also is wise, and will bring disaster, and will not call back his words, but will arise against the house of the evildoers, and against the help of those who work iniquity.
verses.zh: 其实，耶和华有智慧；他必降灾祸，并不反悔自己的话，却要兴起攻击那作恶之家，又攻击那作孽帮助人的。

words.g: to do or make , especially to practise

verses.en: Now the Egyptians are men, and not God; and their horses flesh, and not spirit. When the LORD stretches out his hand, both he who helps shall stumble, and he who is helped shall fall, and they all shall be consumed together.
verses.zh: 埃及人不过是人，并不是神；他们的马不过是血肉，并不是灵。耶和华一伸手，那帮助人的必绊跌，那受帮助的也必跌倒，都一同灭亡。

words.g: and + Mitsrajim, i.e. Upper and Lower Egypt
to surround, i.e. protect or aid
to surround, i.e. protect or aid
to end, whether intransitive  or transitived

verses.en: For the LORD says to me, “As the lion and the young lion growling over his prey, if a multitude of shepherds is called together against him, will not be dismayed at their voice, nor abase himself for their noise, so the LORD of Armies will come down to fight on Mount Zion and on its heights.
verses.zh: 耶和华对我如此说：狮子和少壮狮子护食咆哮，就是喊许多牧人来攻击它，它总不因他们的声音惊惶，也不因他们的喧哗缩伏。如此，万军之耶和华也必降临在锡安山冈上争战。

words.g: a mass of persons , especially reg. organized forwar

verses.en: As birds hovering, so the LORD of Armies will protect Jerusalem. He will protect and deliver it. He will pass over and preserve it.”
verses.zh: 雀鸟怎样搧翅覆雏，万军之耶和华也要照样保护耶路撒冷。他必保护拯救，要越门保守。

words.g: a mass of persons , especially reg. organized forwar
Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine
and + to be smooth, i.e.  to escape

verses.en: Return to him from whom you have deeply revolted, children of Israel.
verses.zh: 以色列人哪，你们深深地悖逆耶和华，现今要归向他。

verses.en: For in that day everyone shall cast away his idols of silver and his idols of gold—sin which your own hands have made for you.
verses.zh: 到那日，各人必将他金偶像银偶像，就是亲手所造、陷自己在罪中的，都抛弃了。

words.g: good for nothing, by anal. vain or vanity
and + good for nothing, by anal. vain or vanity

verses.en: “The Assyrian will fall by the sword, not of man; and the sword, not of mankind, shall devour him. He will flee from the sword, and his young men will become subject to forced labor.
verses.zh: 亚述人必倒在刀下，并非人的刀；有刀要将他吞灭，并非人的刀。他必逃避这刀；他的少年人必成为服苦的。

words.g: Ashshur, the second son of Shem
and + to flit, i.e. vanish away
to + a burden , i.e. a tax in the form of forced labor

verses.en: His rock will pass away by reason of terror, and his princes will be afraid of the banner,” says the LORD, whose fire is in Zion, and his furnace in Jerusalem.
verses.zh: 他的磐石必因惊吓挪去；他的首领必因大旗惊惶。这是那有火在锡安、有炉在耶路撒冷的耶和华说的。

words.g: and + a craggy rock, literally or figuratively + +him/his/it
in + Tsijon , a mountain of Jerusalem
in + Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine

verses.en: Behold, a king shall reign in righteousness, and princes shall rule in justice.
verses.zh: 看哪，必有一王凭公义行政；必有首领藉公平掌权。

verses.en: A man shall be as a hiding place from the wind, and a covert from the storm, as streams of water in a dry place, as the shade of a large rock in a weary land.
verses.zh: 必有一人像避风所和避暴雨的隐密处，又像河流在干旱之地，像大磐石的影子在疲乏之地。

words.g: a craggy rock, literally or figuratively

verses.en: The eyes of those who see will not be dim, and the ears of those who hear will listen.
verses.zh: 那能看的人，眼不再昏迷；能听的人，耳必得听闻。

words.g: to prick up the ears, i.e. hearken

verses.en: The heart of the rash will understand knowledge, and the tongue of the stammerers will be ready to speak plainly.
verses.zh: 冒失人的心必明白知识；结巴人的舌必说话通快。

words.g: to be liquid or flow easily, i.e
to be liquid or flow easily, i.e

verses.en: The fool will no longer be called noble, nor the scoundrel be highly respected.
verses.zh: 愚顽人不再称为高明；吝啬人不再称为大方。

verses.en: For the fool will speak folly, and his heart will work iniquity, to practice profanity, and to utter error against the LORD, to make empty the soul of the hungry, and to cause the drink of the thirsty to fail.
verses.zh: 因为愚顽人必说愚顽话，心里想作罪孽，惯行亵渎的事，说错谬的话攻击耶和华，使饥饿的人无食可吃，使口渴的人无水可喝。

words.g: to + to pour out , i.e. empty
and + causing to drink, i.e. a butler

verses.en: The ways of the scoundrel are evil. He devises wicked plans to destroy the humble with lying words, even when the needy speaks right.
verses.zh: 吝啬人所用的法子是恶的；他图谋恶计，用谎言毁灭谦卑人；穷乏人讲公理的时候，他也是这样行。

words.g: a plan, especially a bad one
to + to wind tightly , i.e. to bind

verses.en: But the noble devises noble things, and he will continue in noble things.
verses.zh: 高明人却谋高明事，在高明事上也必永存。

verses.en: Rise up, you women who are at ease! Hear my voice! You careless daughters, give ear to my speech!
verses.zh: 安逸的妇女啊，起来听我的声音！无虑的女子啊，侧耳听我的言语！

words.g: to broaden out the ear , i.e.  to listen

verses.en: For days beyond a year you will be troubled, you careless women; for the vintage will fail. The harvest won’t come.
verses.zh: 无虑的女子啊，再过一年多，必受骚扰；因为无葡萄可摘，无果子（或译：禾稼）可收。

words.g: to end, whether intransitive  or transitived

verses.en: Tremble, you women who are at ease! Be troubled, you careless ones! Strip yourselves, make yourselves naked, and put sackcloth on your waist.
verses.zh: 安逸的妇女啊，要战兢；无虑的女子啊，要受骚扰。脱去衣服，赤着身体，腰束麻布。

verses.en: Beat your breasts for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vine.
verses.zh: 她们必为美好的田地和多结果的葡萄树，捶胸哀哭。

words.g: the breast of a woman or animal
to tear the hair and beat the breasts

verses.en: Thorns and briers will come up on my people’s land; yes, on all the houses of joy in the joyous city.
verses.zh: 荆棘蒺藜必长在我百姓的地上，又长在欢乐的城中和一切快乐的房屋上。

verses.en: For the palace will be forsaken. The populous city will be deserted. The hill and the watchtower will be for dens forever, a delight for wild donkeys, a pasture of flocks,
verses.zh: 因为宫殿必被撇下，多民的城必被离弃；山冈望楼永为洞穴，作野驴所喜乐的，为羊群的草场。

verses.en: until the Spirit is poured on us from on high, and the wilderness becomes a fruitful field, and the fruitful field is considered a forest.
verses.zh: 等到圣灵从上浇灌我们，旷野就变为肥田，肥田看如树林。

verses.en: Then justice will dwell in the wilderness; and righteousness will remain in the fruitful field.
verses.zh: 那时，公平要居在旷野；公义要居在肥田。

words.g: and + to reside or permanently stay

verses.en: The work of righteousness will be peace, and the effect of righteousness, quietness and confidence forever.
verses.zh: 公义的果效必是平安；公义的效验必是平稳，直到永远。

verses.en: My people will live in a peaceful habitation, in safe dwellings, and in quiet resting places,
verses.zh: 我的百姓必住在平安的居所，安稳的住处，平静的安歇所。

verses.en: though hail flattens the forest, and the city is leveled completely.
verses.zh: （但要降冰雹打倒树林；城必全然拆平。）

verses.en: Blessed are you who sow beside all waters, who send out the feet of the ox and the donkey.
verses.zh: 你们在各水边撒种、牧放牛驴的有福了！

verses.en: Woe to you who destroy, but you weren’t destroyed, and who betray, but nobody betrayed you! When you have finished destroying, you will be destroyed; and when you have finished betrayal, you will be betrayed.
verses.zh: 祸哉！你这毁灭人的，自己倒不被毁灭；行事诡诈的，人倒不以诡诈待你。你毁灭罢休了，自己必被毁灭；你行完了诡诈，人必以诡诈待你。

words.g: and + thou and thee, or  ye and you
like + to complete, in a good or a bad sense + +you/your

verses.en: LORD, be gracious to us. We have waited for you. Be our strength every morning, our salvation also in the time of trouble.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，求你施恩于我们；我们等候你。求你每早晨作我们的膀臂，遭难的时候为我们的拯救。

verses.en: At the noise of the thunder, the peoples have fled. When you lift yourself up, the nations are scattered.
verses.zh: 喧嚷的响声一发，众民奔逃；你一兴起，列国四散。

words.g: to dash to pieces, or scatter

verses.en: Your plunder will be gathered as the caterpillar gathers. Men will leap on it as locusts leap.
verses.zh: 你们所掳的必被敛尽，好像蚂蚱吃（原文是敛）尽禾稼。人要蹦在其上，好像蝗虫一样。

words.g: and + to gather for any purpose
the + the ravager, i.e. a locust
like + a traversing, i.e. rapid motion

verses.en: The LORD is exalted, for he dwells on high. He has filled Zion with justice and righteousness.
verses.zh: 耶和华被尊崇，因他居在高处；他以公平公义充满锡安。

verses.en: There will be stability in your times, abundance of salvation, wisdom, and knowledge. The fear of the LORD is your treasure.
verses.zh: 你一生一世必得安稳―有丰盛的救恩，并智慧和知识；你以敬畏耶和华为至宝。

verses.en: Behold, their valiant ones cry outside; the ambassadors of peace weep bitterly.
verses.zh: 看哪，他们的豪杰在外头哀号；求和的使臣痛痛哭泣。

verses.en: The highways are desolate. The traveling man ceases. The covenant is broken. He has despised the cities. He doesn’t respect man.
verses.zh: 大路荒凉，行人止息；敌人背约，藐视城邑，不顾人民。

words.g: to stun , i.e. devastate or  stupefy
to repose, i.e. desist from exertion
to break up , i.e. to violate

verses.en: The land mourns and languishes. Lebanon is confounded and withers away. Sharon is like a desert, and Bashan and Carmel are stripped bare.
verses.zh: 地上悲哀衰残；黎巴嫩羞愧枯干；沙仑像旷野；巴珊和迦密的树林凋残。

words.g: Lebanon, a mountain range in Palestine
Bashan , a region East of the Jordan
and + Karmel, the name of a hill and of a town in Palestine

verses.en: “Now I will arise,” says the LORD. “Now I will lift myself up. Now I will be exalted.
verses.zh: 耶和华说：现在我要起来；我要兴起；我要勃然而兴。

words.g: to be high actively, to rise or raise

verses.en: You will conceive chaff. You will give birth to stubble. Your breath is a fire that will devour you.
verses.zh: 你们要怀的是糠秕，要生的是碎秸；你们的气就是吞灭自己的火。

verses.en: The peoples will be like the burning of lime, like thorns that are cut down and burned in the fire.
verses.zh: 列邦必像已烧的石灰，像已割的荆棘在火中焚烧。

words.g: to burn or set on fire

verses.en: Hear, you who are far off, what I have done; and, you who are near, acknowledge my might.”
verses.zh: 你们远方的人当听我所行的；你们近处的人当承认我的大能。

verses.en: The sinners in Zion are afraid. Trembling has seized the godless ones. Who among us can live with the devouring fire? Who among us can live with everlasting burning?
verses.zh: 锡安中的罪人都惧怕；不敬虔的人被战兢抓住。我们中间谁能与吞灭的火同住？我们中间谁能与永火同住呢？

words.g: in + Tsijon , a mountain of Jerusalem
to turn aside from the road , i.e. sojourn
to turn aside from the road , i.e. sojourn

verses.zh: 希西家喜欢见使者，就把自己宝库的金子、银子、香料、贵重的膏油，和他武库的一切军器，并所有的财宝都给他们看；他家中和全国之内，希西家没有一样不给他们看的。

verses.en: Then Isaiah the prophet came to King Hezekiah, and asked him, “What did these men say? From where did they come to you?” Hezekiah said, “They have come from a country far from me, even from Babylon.”
verses.zh: 于是先知以赛亚来见希西家王，问他说：「这些人说甚么？他们从哪里来见你？」希西家说：「他们从远方的巴比伦来见我。」

words.g: Jeshajah, the name of seven Israelites
the + a prophet or  inspired man
from + Babel , including Babylonia and the Babylonian empire

verses.en: Then he asked, “What have they seen in your house?” Hezekiah answered, “They have seen all that is in my house. There is nothing among my treasures that I have not shown them.”
verses.zh: 以赛亚说：「他们在你家里看见了甚么？」希西家说：「凡我家中所有的，他们都看见了；我财宝中没有一样不给他们看的。」

verses.en: Then Isaiah said to Hezekiah, “Hear the word of the LORD of Armies:
verses.zh: 以赛亚对希西家说：「你要听万军之耶和华的话：

words.g: Jeshajah, the name of seven Israelites
a mass of persons , especially reg. organized forwar

verses.en: ‘Behold, the days are coming when all that is in your house, and that which your fathers have stored up until today, will be carried to Babylon. Nothing will be left,’ says the LORD.
verses.zh: 日子必到，凡你家里所有的，并你列祖积蓄到如今的，都要被掳到巴比伦去，不留下一样；这是耶和华说的。

words.g: father, in a literal and immediate + +you/your
Babel , including Babylonia and the Babylonian empire

verses.en: ‘They will take away your sons who will issue from you, whom you shall father, and they will be eunuchs in the king of Babylon’s palace.’”
verses.zh: 并且从你本身所生的众子，其中必有被掳去、在巴比伦王宫里当太监的。」

words.g: Babel , including Babylonia and the Babylonian empire

verses.en: Then Hezekiah said to Isaiah, “The LORD’s word which you have spoken is good.” He said moreover, “For there will be peace and truth in my days.”
verses.zh: 希西家对以赛亚说：「你所说耶和华的话甚好，因为在我的年日中必有太平和稳固的景况。」

words.g: Jeshajah, the name of seven Israelites

verses.en: “Comfort, comfort my people,” says your God.
verses.zh: 你们的神说：你们要安慰，安慰我的百姓。

verses.en: “Speak comfortably to Jerusalem, and call out to her that her warfare is accomplished, that her iniquity is pardoned, that she has received of the LORD’s hand double for all her sins.”
verses.zh: 要对耶路撒冷说安慰的话，又向她宣告说，她争战的日子已满了；她的罪孽赦免了；她为自己的一切罪，从耶和华手中加倍受罚。

words.g: Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine
a mass of persons , especially reg. organized forwar + +her/its

verses.en: The voice of one who calls out, “Prepare the way of the LORD in the wilderness! Make a level highway in the desert for our God.
verses.zh: 有人声喊着说：在旷野预备耶和华的路（或译：在旷野，有人声喊着说：当预备耶和华的路），在沙漠地修平我们神的道。

verses.en: Every valley shall be exalted, and every mountain and hill shall be made low. The uneven shall be made level, and the rough places a plain.
verses.zh: 一切山洼都要填满，大小山冈都要削平；高高低低的要改为平坦，崎崎岖岖的必成为平原。

words.g: to + a level, i.e. a plain  as a proper name of certain districts)
to + a split, i.e. a wide level valley between mountains

verses.en: The LORD’s glory shall be revealed, and all flesh shall see it together; for the mouth of the LORD has spoken it.”
verses.zh: 耶和华的荣耀必然显现；凡有血气的必一同看见；因为这是耶和华亲口说的。

words.g: weight, but only figuratively in a good sense
the mouth , whether literal or figurative

verses.en: The voice of one saying, “Cry out!” One said, “What shall I cry?” “All flesh is like grass, and all its glory is like the flower of the field.
verses.zh: 有人声说：你喊叫吧！有一个说：我喊叫甚么呢？说：凡有血气的尽都如草；他的美容都像野地的花。

words.g: like + glistening, i.e. a burnished plate

verses.en: The grass withers, the flower fades, because the LORD’s breath blows on it. Surely the people are like grass.
verses.zh: 草必枯干，花必凋残，因为耶和华的气吹在其上；百姓诚然是草。

verses.en: The grass withers, the flower fades; but the word of our God stands forever.”
verses.zh: 草必枯干，花必凋残，惟有我们神的话必永远立定。

verses.en: You who tell good news to Zion, go up on a high mountain. You who tell good news to Jerusalem, lift up your voice with strength! Lift it up! Don’t be afraid! Say to the cities of Judah, “Behold, your God!”
verses.zh: 报好信息给锡安的啊，你要登高山；报好信息给耶路撒冷的啊，你要极力扬声。扬声不要惧怕，对犹大的城邑说：看哪，你们的神！

words.g: to be fresh, i.e. full  cheerful)
to be high actively, to rise or raise
to be fresh, i.e. full  cheerful)
Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine
to be high actively, to rise or raise
Jehudah , the name of five Israelites

verses.en: Behold, the Lord GOD will come as a mighty one, and his arm will rule for him. Behold, his reward is with him, and his recompense before him.
verses.zh: 主耶和华必像大能者临到；他的膀臂必为他掌权。他的赏赐在他那里；他的报应在他面前。

words.g: and + the arm , or  the foreleg + +him/his/it

verses.en: He will feed his flock like a shepherd. He will gather the lambs in his arm, and carry them in his bosom. He will gently lead those who have their young.
verses.zh: 他必像牧人牧养自己的羊群，用膀臂聚集羊羔抱在怀中，慢慢引导那乳养小羊的。

words.g: in + the arm , or  the foreleg + +him/his/it

verses.en: Who has measured the waters in the hollow of his hand, and marked off the sky with his span, and calculated the dust of the earth in a measuring basket, and weighed the mountains in scales, and the hills in a balance?
verses.zh: 谁曾用手心量诸水，用手虎口量苍天，用升斗盛大地的尘土，用秤称山岭，用天平平冈陵呢？

words.g: in + the spread of the fingers, i.e. a span
in + a triple, i.e.  a triangle

verses.en: Who has directed the LORD’s Spirit, or has taught him as his counselor?
verses.zh: 谁曾测度耶和华的心（或译：谁曾指示耶和华的灵），或作他的谋士指教他呢？

verses.en: Who did he take counsel with, and who instructed him, and taught him in the path of justice, and taught him knowledge, and showed him the way of understanding?
verses.zh: 他与谁商议，谁教导他，谁将公平的路指示他，又将知识教训他，将通达的道指教他呢？

words.g: and + to separate mentally , i.e. understand + +him/his/it
and + to goad, i.e.  to teach + +him/his/it
and + to goad, i.e.  to teach + +him/his/it

verses.en: Behold, the nations are like a drop in a bucket, and are regarded as a speck of dust on a balance. Behold, he lifts up the islands like a very little thing.
verses.zh: 看哪，万民都像水桶的一滴，又算如天平上的微尘；他举起众海岛，好像极微之物。

words.g: like + crushed, i.e.  small or thin

verses.en: Lebanon is not sufficient to burn, nor its animals sufficient for a burnt offering.
verses.zh: 黎巴嫩的树林不够当柴烧；其中的走兽也不够作燔祭。

words.g: and + Lebanon, a mountain range in Palestine
enough , used chiefly with preposition in phrases
enough , used chiefly with preposition in phrases

verses.en: All the nations are like nothing before him. They are regarded by him as less than nothing, and vanity.
verses.zh: 万民在他面前好像虚无，被他看为不及虚无，乃为虚空。

verses.en: To whom then will you liken God? Or what likeness will you compare to him?
verses.zh: 你们究竟将谁比神，用甚么形像与神比较呢？

words.g: to set in a row, i.e. arrange

verses.en: A workman has cast an image, and the goldsmith overlays it with gold, and casts silver chains for it.
verses.zh: 偶像是匠人铸造，银匠用金包裹，为它铸造银链。

words.g: to pour out, especially a libation
and + something fastened, i.e. a chain

verses.en: He who is too impoverished for such an offering chooses a tree that will not rot. He seeks a skillful workman to set up a carved image for him that will not be moved.
verses.zh: 穷乏献不起这样供物的，就拣选不能朽坏的树木，为自己寻找巧匠，立起不能摇动的偶像。

words.g: a present , especially in sacrifice or as tribute

verses.en: Haven’t you known? Haven’t you heard? Haven’t you been told from the beginning? Haven’t you understood from the foundations of the earth?
verses.zh: 你们岂不曾知道吗？你们岂不曾听见吗？从起初岂没有人告诉你们吗？自从立地的根基，你们岂没有明白吗？

verses.en: It is he who sits above the circle of the earth, and its inhabitants are like grasshoppers; who stretches out the heavens like a curtain, and spreads them out like a tent to dwell in,
verses.zh: 神坐在地球大圈之上；地上的居民好像蝗虫。他铺张穹苍如幔子，展开诸天如可住的帐棚。

words.g: the + to stretch or spread out

verses.en: who brings princes to nothing, who makes the judges of the earth meaningless.
verses.zh: 他使君王归于虚无，使地上的审判官成为虚空。

words.g: probably to be heavy, i.e.  honorable

verses.en: They are planted scarcely. They are sown scarcely. Their stock has scarcely taken root in the ground. He merely blows on them, and they wither, and the whirlwind takes them away as stubble.
verses.zh: 他们是刚才（或译：不曾；下同）栽上，刚才种上，根也刚才扎在地里，他一吹在其上，便都枯干；旋风将他们吹去，像碎秸一样。

words.g: to root, i.e. strike into the soil
the trunk or stump of atree + +them/their
to breeze, i.e. blow up fresh

verses.en: “To whom then will you liken me? Who is my equal?” says the Holy One.
verses.zh: 那圣者说：你们将谁比我，叫他与我相等呢？

verses.en: Lift up your eyes on high, and see who has created these, who brings out their army by number. He calls them all by name. By the greatness of his might, and because he is strong in power, not one is lacking.
verses.zh: 你们向上举目，看谁创造这万象，按数目领出，他一一称其名；因他的权能，又因他的大能大力，连一个都不缺。

words.g: in + a number, definite  or indefinite
a mass of persons , especially reg. organized forwar + +them/their
to arrange as a battle, a vineyard

verses.en: Why do you say, Jacob, and speak, Israel, “My way is hidden from the LORD, and the justice due me is disregarded by my God”?
verses.zh: 雅各啊，你为何说，我的道路向耶和华隐藏？以色列啊，你为何言，我的冤屈神并不查问？

verses.en: Haven’t you known? Haven’t you heard? The everlasting God, the LORD, the Creator of the ends of the earth, doesn’t faint. He isn’t weary. His understanding is unsearchable.
verses.zh: 你岂不曾知道吗？你岂不曾听见吗？永在的神耶和华，创造地极的主，并不疲乏，也不困倦；他的智慧无法测度。

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.en: He gives power to the weak. He increases the strength of him who has no might.
verses.zh: 疲乏的，他赐能力；软弱的，他加力量。

verses.en: Even the youths faint and get weary, and the young men utterly fall;
verses.zh: 就是少年人也要疲乏困倦；强壮的也必全然跌倒。

words.g: a boy , from the age of infancy to adolescence

verses.en: but those who wait for the LORD will renew their strength. They will mount up with wings like eagles. They will run, and not be weary. They will walk, and not faint.
verses.zh: 但那等候耶和华的必重新得力。他们必如鹰展翅上腾；他们奔跑却不困倦，行走却不疲乏。

words.g: and + to bind together , i.e. collect
to slide by, i.e.  to hasten away

verses.en: “Keep silent before me, islands, and let the peoples renew their strength. Let them come near, then let them speak. Let’s meet together for judgment.
verses.zh: 众海岛啊，当在我面前静默；众民当重新得力，都要近前来才可以说话，我们可以彼此辩论。

words.g: to slide by, i.e.  to hasten away

verses.en: Who has raised up one from the east? Who called him to his feet in righteousness? He hands over nations to him and makes him rule over kings. He gives them like the dust to his sword, like the driven stubble to his bow.
verses.zh: 谁从东方兴起一人，凭公义召他来到脚前呢？耶和华将列国交给他，使他管辖君王，把他们如灰尘交与他的刀，如风吹的碎秸交与他的弓。

words.g: a bow, forshooting  or the iris + +him/his/it

verses.en: He pursues them and passes by safely, even by a way that he had not gone with his feet.
verses.zh: 他追赶他们，走他所未走的道，坦然前行。

verses.en: Who has worked and done it, calling the generations from the beginning? I, the LORD, the first, and with the last, I am he.”
verses.zh: 谁行做成就这事，从起初宣召历代呢？就是我―耶和华！我是首先的，也与末后的同在。

words.g: to do or make , especially to practise

verses.en: The islands have seen, and fear. The ends of the earth tremble. They approach, and come.
verses.zh: 海岛看见就都害怕；地极也都战兢，就近前来。

verses.en: Everyone helps his neighbor. They say to their brothers, “Be strong!”
verses.zh: 他们各人帮助邻舍，各人对弟兄说：壮胆吧！

words.g: to surround, i.e. protect or aid

verses.en: So the carpenter encourages the goldsmith. He who smooths with the hammer encourages him who strikes the anvil, saying of the soldering, “It is good;” and he fastens it with nails, that it might not totter.
verses.zh: 木匠勉励银匠，用锤打光的勉励打砧的，论焊工说，焊得好；又用钉子钉稳，免得偶像动摇。

verses.en: “But you, Israel, my servant, Jacob whom I have chosen, the offspring of Abraham my friend,
verses.zh: 惟你以色列―我的仆人，雅各―我所拣选的，我朋友亚伯拉罕的后裔，

words.g: and + thou and thee, or  ye and you
Abraham, the later name of Abram

verses.en: you whom I have taken hold of from the ends of the earth, and called from its corners, and said to you, ‘You are my servant. I have chosen you and have not cast you away.’
verses.zh: 你是我从地极所领（原文是抓）来的，从地角所召来的，且对你说：你是我的仆人；我拣选你，并不弃绝你。

words.g: and + from + an extremity , also a noble + +her/its
thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: Don’t you be afraid, for I am with you. Don’t be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help you. Yes, I will uphold you with the right hand of my righteousness.
verses.zh: 你不要害怕，因为我与你同在；不要惊惶，因为我是你的神。我必坚固你，我必帮助你；我必用我公义的右手扶持你。

words.g: to be alert, physically  or mentally + +you/your
to surround, i.e. protect or aid + +you/your

verses.en: Behold, all those who are incensed against you will be disappointed and confounded. Those who strive with you will be like nothing, and shall perish.
verses.zh: 凡向你发怒的必都抱愧蒙羞；与你相争的必如无有，并要灭亡。

words.g: to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed

verses.en: You will seek them, and won’t find them, even those who contend with you. Those who war against you will be as nothing, as a nonexistent thing.
verses.zh: 与你争竞的，你要找他们也找不着；与你争战的必如无有，成为虚无。

words.g: and + like + cessation, i.e. an end

verses.en: For I, the LORD your God, will hold your right hand, saying to you, ‘Don’t be afraid. I will help you.’
verses.zh: 因为我耶和华―你的神必搀扶你的右手，对你说：不要害怕！我必帮助你。

words.g: to surround, i.e. protect or aid + +you/your

verses.en: Don’t be afraid, you worm Jacob, and you men of Israel. I will help you,” says the LORD. “Your Redeemer is the Holy One of Israel.
verses.zh: 你这虫雅各和你们以色列人，不要害怕！耶和华说：我必帮助你。你的救赎主就是以色列的圣者。

words.g: to surround, i.e. protect or aid + +you/your
and + to be the next of kin + +you/your

verses.en: Behold, I have made you into a new sharp threshing instrument with teeth. You will thresh the mountains, and beat them small, and will make the hills like chaff.
verses.zh: 看哪，我已使你成为有快齿打粮的新器具；你要把山岭打得粉碎，使冈陵如同糠秕。

verses.en: You will winnow them, and the wind will carry them away, and the whirlwind will scatter them. You will rejoice in the LORD. You will glory in the Holy One of Israel.
verses.zh: 你要把它簸扬，风要吹去；旋风要把它刮散。你倒要以耶和华为喜乐，以以色列的圣者为夸耀。

words.g: to dash in pieces, literally or figuratively
and + thou and thee, or  ye and you
to spin round , i.e. usually rejoice

verses.en: The poor and needy seek water, and there is none. Their tongue fails for thirst. I, the LORD, will answer them. I, the God of Israel, will not forsake them.
verses.zh: 困苦穷乏人寻求水却没有；他们因口渴，舌头干燥。我―耶和华必应允他们；我―以色列的神必不离弃他们。

words.g: the + depressed, in mind or circumstances
to eliminate, i.e.  to dry up

verses.en: I will open rivers on the bare heights, and springs in the middle of the valleys. I will make the wilderness a pool of water, and the dry land springs of water.
verses.zh: 我要在净光的高处开江河，在谷中开泉源；我要使沙漠变为水池，使干地变为涌泉。

words.g: a split, i.e. a wide level valley between mountains
to + a going forth, i.e.  an egress

verses.en: I will put cedar, acacia, myrtle, and oil trees in the wilderness. I will set cypress trees, pine, and box trees together in the desert;
verses.zh: 我要在旷野种上香柏树、皂荚树、番石榴树，和野橄榄树。我在沙漠要把松树、杉树，并黄杨树一同栽植；

verses.en: that they may see, know, consider, and understand together, that the LORD’s hand has done this, and the Holy One of Israel has created it.
verses.zh: 好叫人看见、知道、思想、明白；这是耶和华的手所做的，是以色列的圣者所造的。

words.g: and + to be  circumspect and hence, intelligent

verses.en: Produce your cause,” says the LORD. “Bring out your strong reasons!” says the King of Jacob.
verses.zh: 耶和华对假神说：你们要呈上你们的案件；雅各的君说：你们要声明你们确实的理由。

verses.en: “Let them announce and declare to us what will happen! Declare the former things, what they are, that we may consider them, and know the latter end of them; or show us things to come.
verses.zh: 可以声明，指示我们将来必遇的事，说明先前的是甚么事，好叫我们思索，得知事的结局，或者把将来的事指示我们。

verses.en: Declare the things that are to come hereafter, that we may know that you are gods. Yes, do good, or do evil, that we may be dismayed, and see it together.
verses.zh: 要说明后来的事，好叫我们知道你们是神。你们或降福，或降祸，使我们惊奇，一同观看。

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you
and + to gaze at or about

verses.en: Behold, you are nothing, and your work is nothing. He who chooses you is an abomination.
verses.zh: 看哪，你们属乎虚无；你们的作为也属乎虚空。那选择你们的是可憎恶的。

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: “I have raised up one from the north, and he has come, from the rising of the sun, one who calls on my name, and he shall come on rulers as on mortar, and as the potter treads clay.
verses.zh: 我从北方兴起一人；他是求告我名的，从日出之地而来。他必临到掌权的，好像临到灰泥，彷佛窑匠踹泥一样。

words.g: a form of the prefix 'k-', but used separately  as
a bubbling up, i.e. of water
and + a form of the prefix 'k-', but used separately  as
