verses.zh: 谁从起初指明这事，使我们知道呢？谁从先前说明，使我们说他不错呢？谁也没有指明；谁也没有说明；谁也没有听见你们的话。

verses.en: I am the first to say to Zion, ‘Behold, look at them;’ and I will give one who brings good news to Jerusalem.
verses.zh: 我首先对锡安说：看哪，我要将一位报好信息的赐给耶路撒冷。

words.g: to + Tsijon , a mountain of Jerusalem
and + to + Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine
to be fresh, i.e. full  cheerful)

verses.en: When I look, there is no man, even among them there is no counselor who, when I ask, can answer a word.
verses.zh: 我看的时候并没有人；我问的时候，他们中间也没有谋士可以回答一句。

verses.en: Behold, all of their deeds are vanity and nothing. Their molten images are wind and confusion.
verses.zh: 看哪，他们和他们的工作都是虚空，且是虚无。他们所铸的偶像都是风，都是虚的。

verses.en: “Behold, my servant, whom I uphold, my chosen, in whom my soul delights: I have put my Spirit on him. He will bring justice to the nations.
verses.zh: 看哪，我的仆人―我所扶持所拣选、心里所喜悦的！我已将我的灵赐给他；他必将公理传给外邦。

verses.en: He will not shout, nor raise his voice, nor cause it to be heard in the street.
verses.zh: 他不喧嚷，不扬声，也不使街上听见他的声音。

words.g: in + separate by awall, i.e. outside

verses.en: He won’t break a bruised reed. He won’t quench a dimly burning wick. He will faithfully bring justice.
verses.zh: 压伤的芦苇，他不折断；将残的灯火，他不吹灭。他凭真实将公理传开。

words.g: to crack in pieces, literally or figuratively

verses.en: He will not fail nor be discouraged, until he has set justice on the earth, and the islands wait for his law.”
verses.zh: 他不灰心，也不丧胆，直到他在地上设立公理；海岛都等候他的训诲。

words.g: to be weak, i.e.  to despond
to crack in pieces, literally or figuratively

verses.zh: 创造诸天，铺张穹苍，将地和地所出的一并铺开，赐气息给地上的众人，又赐灵性给行在其上之人的神耶和华，他如此说：

verses.zh: 我―耶和华凭公义召你，必搀扶你的手，保守你，使你作众民的中保（中保：原文是约），作外邦人的光，

verses.en: to open the blind eyes, to bring the prisoners out of the dungeon, and those who sit in darkness out of the prison.
verses.zh: 开瞎子的眼，领被囚的出牢狱，领坐黑暗的出监牢。

words.g: from + a fastener, i.e.  a smith

verses.zh: 我是耶和华，这是我的名；我必不将我的荣耀归给假神，也不将我的称赞归给雕刻的偶像。

words.g: and + weight, but only figuratively in a good sense + +me/my

verses.en: Behold, the former things have happened and I declare new things. I tell you about them before they come up.”
verses.zh: 看哪，先前的事已经成就，现在我将新事说明，这事未发以先，我就说给你们听。

verses.en: Sing to the LORD a new song, and his praise from the end of the earth, you who go down to the sea, and all that is therein, the islands and their inhabitants.
verses.zh: 航海的和海中所有的，海岛和其上的居民，都当向耶和华唱新歌，从地极赞美他。

verses.en: Let the wilderness and its cities raise their voices, with the villages that Kedar inhabits. Let the inhabitants of Sela sing. Let them shout from the top of the mountains!
verses.zh: 旷野和其中的城邑，并基达人居住的村庄都当扬声；西拉的居民当欢呼，在山顶上呐喊。

verses.en: Let them give glory to the LORD, and declare his praise in the islands.
verses.zh: 他们当将荣耀归给耶和华，在海岛中传扬他的颂赞。

words.g: weight, but only figuratively in a good sense

verses.en: The LORD will go out like a mighty man. He will stir up zeal like a man of war. He will raise a war cry. Yes, he will shout aloud. He will triumph over his enemies.
verses.zh: 耶和华必像勇士出去，必像战士激动热心，要喊叫，大声呐喊，要用大力攻击仇敌。

words.g: to be clear , i.e. to whoop

verses.en: “I have been silent a long time. I have been quiet and restrained myself. Now I will cry out like a travailing woman. I will both gasp and pant.
verses.zh: 我许久闭口不言，静默不语；现在我要喊叫，像产难的妇人；我要急气而喘哮。

verses.en: I will destroy mountains and hills, and dry up all their herbs. I will make the rivers islands, and will dry up the pools.
verses.zh: 我要使大山小冈变为荒场，使其上的花草都枯干；我要使江河变为洲岛，使水池都干涸。

words.g: to parch  i.e.  to desolate, destroy

verses.en: I will bring the blind by a way that they don’t know. I will lead them in paths that they don’t know. I will make darkness light before them, and crooked places straight. I will do these things, and I will not forsake them.
verses.zh: 我要引瞎子行不认识的道，领他们走不知道的路；在他们面前使黑暗变为光明，使弯曲变为平直。这些事我都要行，并不离弃他们。

verses.en: “Those who trust in engraved images, who tell molten images, ‘You are our gods,’ will be turned back. They will be utterly disappointed.
verses.zh: 倚靠雕刻的偶像，对铸造的偶像说：你是我们的神；这等人要退后，全然蒙羞。

verses.zh: 你们这耳聋的，听吧！你们这眼瞎的，看吧！使你们能看见。

verses.en: Who is blind, but my servant? Or who is as deaf as my messenger whom I send? Who is as blind as he who is at peace, and as blind as the LORD’s servant?
verses.zh: 谁比我的仆人眼瞎呢？谁比我差遣的使者耳聋呢？谁瞎眼像那与我和好的？谁瞎眼像耶和华的仆人呢？

verses.zh: 你看见许多事却不领会，耳朵开通却不听见。

verses.en: It pleased the LORD, for his righteousness’ sake, to magnify the law and make it honorable.
verses.zh: 耶和华因自己公义的缘故，喜欢使律法（或译：训诲）为大，为尊。

words.g: and + to expand, i.e. be great or  magnificent

verses.zh: 但这百姓是被抢被夺的，都牢笼在坑中，隐藏在狱里；他们作掠物，无人拯救，作掳物，无人说交还。

words.g: in + the crevice of a serpent

verses.en: Who is there among you who will give ear to this? Who will listen and hear for the time to come?

to prick up the ears, i.e. hearken

verses.en: Who gave Jacob as plunder, and Israel to the robbers? Didn’t the LORD, he against whom we have sinned? For they would not walk in his ways, and they disobeyed his law.
verses.zh: 谁将雅各交出当作掳物，将以色列交给抢夺的呢？岂不是耶和华吗？就是我们所得罪的那位。他们不肯遵行他的道，也不听从他的训诲。

words.g: to breathe after, i.e.  to be acquiescent

verses.zh: 所以，他将猛烈的怒气和争战的勇力倾倒在以色列的身上。在他四围如火着起，他还不知道，烧着他，他也不介意。

words.g: and + to lick, i.e.  to blaze + +him/his/it

verses.zh: 雅各啊，创造你的耶和华，以色列啊，造成你的那位，现在如此说：你不要害怕！因为我救赎了你。我曾提你的名召你，你是属我的。

to be the next of kin + +you/your
thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.zh: 你从水中经过，我必与你同在；你蹚过江河，水必不漫过你；你从火中行过，必不被烧，火焰也不着在你身上。

verses.zh: 因为我是耶和华―你的神，是以色列的圣者―你的救主；我已经使埃及作你的赎价，使古实和西巴代替你。

words.g: to be open, wide or free + +you/your
Mitsrajim, i.e. Upper and Lower Egypt
Cush , the name of a son of Ham
and + Seba, a son of Cush

verses.zh: 因我看你为宝为尊；又因我爱你，所以我使人代替你，使列邦人替换你的生命。

verses.en: Don’t be afraid, for I am with you. I will bring your offspring from the east, and gather you from the west.
verses.zh: 不要害怕，因我与你同在；我必领你的后裔从东方来，又从西方招聚你。

verses.en: I will tell the north, ‘Give them up!’ and tell the south, ‘Don’t hold them back! Bring my sons from far away, and my daughters from the ends of the earth—
verses.zh: 我要对北方说，交出来！对南方说，不要拘留！将我的众子从远方带来，将我的众女从地极领回，

words.g: to restrict, by act  or word

verses.zh: 就是凡称为我名下的人，是我为自己的荣耀创造的，是我所做成，所造作的。

verses.zh: 任凭万国聚集；任凭众民会合。其中谁能将此声明，并将先前的事说给我们听呢？他们可以带出见证来，自显为是；或者他们听见便说：这是真的。

verses.zh: 耶和华说：你们是我的见证，我所拣选的仆人。既是这样，便可以知道，且信服我，又明白我就是耶和华。在我以前没有真神（真：原文是造作的）；在我以后也必没有。

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you
and + to separate mentally , i.e. understand

verses.en: I myself am the LORD. Besides me, there is no savior.
verses.zh: 惟有我是耶和华；除我以外没有救主。

words.g: to be open, wide or free

verses.en: I have declared, I have saved, and I have shown, and there was no strange god among you. Therefore you are my witnesses”, says the LORD, “and I am God.
verses.zh: 我曾指示，我曾拯救，我曾说明，并且在你们中间没有别神。所以耶和华说：你们是我的见证。我也是神；

words.g: and + to be open, wide or free
and + thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: Yes, since the day was, I am he. There is no one who can deliver out of my hand. I will work, and who can hinder it?”
verses.zh: 自从有日子以来，我就是神；谁也不能救人脱离我手。我要行事谁能阻止呢？

words.g: to do or make , especially to practise

verses.en: The LORD, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel says: “For your sake, I have sent to Babylon, and I will bring all of them down as fugitives, even the Chaldeans, in the ships of their rejoicing.
verses.zh: 耶和华―你们的救赎主、以色列的圣者如此说：因你们的缘故，我已经打发人到巴比伦去；并且我要使迦勒底人如逃民，都坐自己喜乐的船下来。

Babel , including Babylonia and the Babylonian empire
in + a fugitive, i.e. the serpent
and + a Kasdite, or descendant of Kesed

verses.zh: 我是耶和华―你们的圣者，是创造以色列的，是你们的君王。

verses.en: The LORD, who makes a way in the sea, and a path in the mighty waters,
verses.zh: 耶和华在沧海中开道，在大水中开路，

verses.zh: 使车辆、马匹、军兵、勇士都出来，一同躺下，不再起来；他们灭没，好像熄灭的灯火。

words.g: probably a force, whether of men

verses.en: “Don’t remember the former things, and don’t consider the things of old.
verses.zh: 耶和华如此说：你们不要记念从前的事，也不要思想古时的事。

verses.en: Behold, I will do a new thing. It springs out now. Don’t you know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.
verses.zh: 看哪，我要做一件新事；如今要发现，你们岂不知道吗？我必在旷野开道路，在沙漠开江河。

verses.en: The animals of the field, the jackals and the ostriches, shall honor me, because I give water in the wilderness and rivers in the desert, to give drink to my people, my chosen,
verses.zh: 野地的走兽必尊重我；野狗和鸵鸟也必如此。因我使旷野有水，使沙漠有河，好赐给我的百姓、我的选民喝。

words.g: a marine or land monster, i.e. sea-serpent or jackal
to + to quaff, i.e.  to irrigate or furnish apotion to

verses.en: the people which I formed for myself, that they might declare my praise.
verses.zh: 这百姓是我为自己所造的，好述说我的美德。

words.g: to score with a mark as a tally or record, i.e.  to inscribe

verses.zh: 雅各啊，你并没有求告我；以色列啊，你倒厌烦我。

verses.en: You have not brought me any of your sheep for burnt offerings, neither have you honored me with your sacrifices. I have not burdened you with offerings, nor wearied you with frankincense.
verses.zh: 你没有将你的羊带来给我作燔祭，也没有用祭物尊敬我；我没有因供物使你服劳，也没有因乳香使你厌烦。

words.g: a member of a flock, i.e. a sheep or goat

verses.zh: 你没有用银子为我买菖蒲，也没有用祭物的脂油使我饱足；倒使我因你的罪恶服劳，使我因你的罪孽厌烦。

words.g: and + fat, whether literally or figuratively
in + an offence , and its penalty + +you/your

verses.en: I, even I, am he who blots out your transgressions for my own sake; and I will not remember your sins.
verses.zh: 惟有我为自己的缘故涂抹你的过犯；我也不记念你的罪恶。

words.g: and + an offence , and its penalty + +you/your

verses.en: Put me in remembrance. Let us plead together. Declare your case, that you may be justified.
verses.zh: 你要提醒我，你我可以一同辩论；你可以将你的理陈明，自显为义。

words.g: to score with a mark as a tally or record, i.e.  to inscribe
thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.zh: 你的始祖犯罪；你的师傅违背我。

words.g: father, in a literal and immediate + +you/your

verses.zh: 所以，我要辱没圣所的首领，使雅各成为咒诅，使以色列成为辱骂。

words.g: and + to bore, i.e.  to wound

verses.zh: 我的仆人雅各，我所拣选的以色列啊，现在你当听。

verses.en: This is what the LORD who made you, and formed you from the womb, who will help you says: “Don’t be afraid, Jacob my servant; and you, Jeshurun, whom I have chosen.
verses.zh: 造作你，又从你出胎造就你，并要帮助你的耶和华如此说：我的仆人雅各，我所拣选的耶书仑哪，不要害怕！

to surround, i.e. protect or aid + +you/your
and + Jeshurun, a symbolic name for Israel

verses.zh: 因为我要将水浇灌口渴的人，将河浇灌干旱之地。我要将我的灵浇灌你的后裔，将我的福浇灌你的子孙。

words.g: and + to drip, or shed by trickling

verses.en: and they will spring up among the grass, as willows by the watercourses.
verses.zh: 他们要发生在草中，像溪水旁的柳树。

verses.en: One will say, ‘I am the LORD’s.’ Another will be called by the name of Jacob; and another will write with his hand ‘to the LORD,’ and honor the name of Israel.”
verses.zh: 这个要说：我是属耶和华的；那个要以雅各的名自称；又一个要亲手写：归耶和华的（或译：在手上写归耶和华），并自称为以色列。

verses.zh: 耶和华―以色列的君，以色列的救赎主―万军之耶和华如此说：我是首先的，我是末后的；除我以外再没有真神。

verses.zh: 自从我设立古时的民，谁能像我宣告，并且指明，又为自己陈说呢？让他将未来的事和必成的事说明。

verses.zh: 你们不要恐惧，也不要害怕。我岂不是从上古就说明指示你们吗？并且你们是我的见证！除我以外，岂有真神吗？诚然没有磐石，我不知道一个！

words.g: and + thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.zh: 制造雕刻偶像的尽都虚空；他们所喜悦的都无益处；他们的见证无所看见，无所知晓，他们便觉羞愧。

verses.zh: 谁制造神像，铸造无益的偶像？

to + a failure of, i.e.  not

verses.zh: 看哪，他的同伴都必羞愧。工匠也不过是人，任他们聚会，任他们站立，都必惧怕，一同羞愧。

verses.zh: 铁匠把铁在火炭中烧热，用锤打铁器，用他有力的膀臂锤成；他饥饿而无力，不喝水而发倦。

verses.zh: 木匠拉线，用笔划出样子，用刨子刨成形状，用圆尺划了模样，仿照人的体态，做成人形，好住在房屋中。

verses.zh: 他砍伐香柏树，又取柞（或译：青桐）树和橡树，在树林中选定了一棵。他栽种松树，得雨长养。

words.g: a species of tree , perhaps the cypress
and + {an oak or other strong tree}
and + to be alert, physically  or mentally

verses.en: Then it will be for a man to burn; and he takes some of it and warms himself. Yes, he burns it and bakes bread. Yes, he makes a god and worships it; he makes it a carved image, and falls down to it.
verses.zh: 这树，人可用以烧火；他自己取些烤火，又烧着烤饼，而且做神像跪拜，做雕刻的偶像向它叩拜。

words.g: and + to cook, especially to bake
to do or make , especially to practise

verses.en: He burns part of it in the fire. With part of it, he eats meat. He roasts a roast and is satisfied. Yes, he warms himself and says, “Aha! I am warm. I have seen the fire.”
verses.zh: 他把一分烧在火中，把一分烤肉吃饱。自己烤火说：「啊哈，我暖和了，我见火了。」

verses.en: The rest of it he makes into a god, even his engraved image. He bows down to it and worships, and prays to it, and says, “Deliver me, for you are my god!”
verses.zh: 他用剩下的做了一神，就是雕刻的偶像。他向这偶像俯伏叩拜，祷告它说：「求你拯救我，因你是我的神。」

words.g: and + a remainder or residual  portion + +him/his/it
thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: They don’t know, neither do they consider, for he has shut their eyes, that they can’t see, and their hearts, that they can’t understand.
verses.zh: 他们不知道，也不思想；因为耶和华闭住他们的眼，不能看见，塞住他们的心，不能明白。

words.g: from + to be  circumspect and hence, intelligent

verses.en: No one thinks, neither is there knowledge nor understanding to say, “I have burned part of it in the fire. Yes, I have also baked bread on its coals. I have roasted meat and eaten it. Shall I make the rest of it into an abomination? Shall I bow down to a tree trunk?”
verses.zh: 谁心里也不醒悟，也没有知识，没有聪明，能说：「我曾拿一分在火中烧了，在炭火上烤过饼；我也烤过肉吃。这剩下的，我岂要作可憎的物吗？我岂可向木墩子叩拜呢？」

words.g: and + an overhanging, i.e.  an excess + +him/his/it
to + something disgusting , i.e.  an abhorrence

verses.en: He feeds on ashes. A deceived heart has turned him aside; and he can’t deliver his soul, nor say, “Isn’t there a lie in my right hand?”
verses.zh: 他以灰为食，心中昏迷，使他偏邪，他不能自救，也不能说：「我右手中岂不是有虚谎吗？」

verses.en: Remember these things, Jacob and Israel, for you are my servant. I have formed you. You are my servant. Israel, you will not be forgotten by me.
verses.zh: 雅各，以色列啊，你是我的仆人，要记念这些事。以色列啊，你是我的仆人，我造就你必不忘记你。

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you
thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: I have blotted out, as a thick cloud, your transgressions, and, as a cloud, your sins. Return to me, for I have redeemed you.
verses.zh: 我涂抹了你的过犯，像厚云消散；我涂抹了你的罪恶，如薄云灭没。你当归向我，因我救赎了你。

words.g: and + like + a cloud , i.e. the nimbus or thunder-cloud
to be the next of kin + +you/your

verses.en: Sing, you heavens, for the LORD has done it! Shout, you lower parts of the earth! Break out into singing, you mountains, O forest, all of your trees, for the LORD has redeemed Jacob, and will glorify himself in Israel.
verses.zh: 诸天哪，应当歌唱，因为耶和华做成这事。地的深处啊，应当欢呼；众山应当发声歌唱；树林和其中所有的树都当如此！因为耶和华救赎了雅各，并要因以色列荣耀自己。

words.g: to be the next of kin

verses.en: The LORD, your Redeemer, and he who formed you from the womb says: “I am the LORD, who makes all things; who alone stretches out the heavens; who spreads out the earth by myself;
verses.zh: 从你出胎，造就你的救赎主―耶和华如此说：我―耶和华是创造万物的，是独自铺张诸天、铺开大地的。谁与我同在呢？

words.g: to be the next of kin + +you/your
and + to mould into a form + +you/your

verses.en: who frustrates the signs of the liars, and makes diviners mad; who turns wise men backward, and makes their knowledge foolish;
verses.zh: 使说假话的兆头失效，使占卜的癫狂，使智慧人退后，使他的知识变为愚拙；

words.g: to break up , i.e. to violate
and + to distribute, i.e. determine by lot or magical scroll

verses.en: who confirms the word of his servant, and performs the counsel of his messengers; who says of Jerusalem, ‘She will be inhabited;’ and of the cities of Judah, ‘They will be built,’ and ‘I will raise up its waste places;’
verses.zh: 使我仆人的话语立定，我使者的谋算成就。论到耶路撒冷说：必有人居住；论到犹大的城邑说：必被建造，其中的荒场我也必兴起。

words.g: to + Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine
Jehudah , the name of five Israelites

verses.en: who says to the deep, ‘Be dry,’ and ‘I will dry up your rivers,’
verses.zh: 对深渊说：你干了吧！我也要使你的江河干涸。

words.g: to parch  i.e.  to desolate, destroy

verses.en: who says of Cyrus, ‘He is my shepherd, and shall perform all my pleasure,’ even saying of Jerusalem, ‘She will be built;’ and of the temple, ‘Your foundation will be laid.’”
verses.zh: 论塞鲁士说：他是我的牧人，必成就我所喜悦的，必下令建造耶路撒冷，发命立稳圣殿的根基。

words.g: to + Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine

verses.en: The LORD says to his anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have held to subdue nations before him and strip kings of their armor, to open the doors before him, and the gates shall not be shut:
verses.zh: 我―耶和华所膏的塞鲁士；我搀扶他的右手，使列国降伏在他面前。我也要放松列王的腰带，使城门在他面前敞开，不得关闭。我对他如此说：

words.g: to + to tread in pieces, i.e.  to conquer
and + the waist or small of the back
something swinging, i.e. the valve of adoor

verses.en: “I will go before you and make the rough places smooth. I will break the doors of bronze in pieces and cut apart the bars of iron.
verses.zh: 我必在你前面行，修平崎岖之地。我必打破铜门，砍断铁闩。

words.g: something swinging, i.e. the valve of adoor

verses.en: I will give you the treasures of darkness and hidden riches of secret places, that you may know that it is I, the LORD, who calls you by your name, even the God of Israel.
verses.zh: 我要将暗中的宝物和隐密的财宝赐给你，使你知道提名召你的，就是我―耶和华、以色列的神。

verses.en: For Jacob my servant’s sake, and Israel my chosen, I have called you by your name. I have given you a title, though you have not known me.
verses.zh: 因我仆人雅各，我所拣选以色列的缘故，我就提名召你；你虽不认识我，我也加给你名号。

words.g: to address by an additional name + +you/your

verses.en: I am the LORD, and there is no one else. Besides me, there is no God. I will strengthen you, though you have not known me,
verses.zh: 我是耶和华，在我以外并没有别神；除了我以外再没有神。你虽不认识我，我必给你束腰。

verses.en: that they may know from the rising of the sun, and from the west, that there is no one besides me. I am the LORD, and there is no one else.
verses.zh: 从日出之地到日落之处使人都知道除了我以外，没有别神。我是耶和华；在我以外并没有别神。

verses.en: I form the light and create darkness. I make peace and create calamity. I am the LORD, who does all these things.
verses.zh: 我造光，又造暗；我施平安，又降灾祸；造作这一切的是我―耶和华。

verses.en: Rain, you heavens, from above, and let the skies pour down righteousness. Let the earth open, that it may produce salvation, and let it cause righteousness to spring up with it. I, the LORD, have created it.
verses.zh: 诸天哪，自上而滴，穹苍降下公义；地面开裂，产出救恩，使公义一同发生；这都是我―耶和华所造的。

words.g: from + the upper part, used only adverbially with prefix upward
to drip, or shed by trickling

verses.en: Woe to him who strives with his Maker— a clay pot among the clay pots of the earth! Shall the clay ask him who fashions it, ‘What are you making?’ or your work, ‘He has no hands’?
verses.zh: 祸哉，那与造他的主争论的！他不过是地上瓦片中的一块瓦片。泥土岂可对抟弄它的说：你做甚么呢？所做的物岂可说：你没有手呢？

words.g: a bubbling up, i.e. of water
to + to mould into a form + +him/his/it

verses.en: Woe to him who says to a father, ‘What have you become the father of?’ or to a mother, ‘What have you given birth to?’”
verses.zh: 祸哉，那对父亲说：你生的是甚么呢？或对母亲（原文是妇人）说：你产的是甚么呢？

words.g: to + father, in a literal and immediate
to twist or whirl , i.e.  to dance

verses.en: The LORD, the Holy One of Israel and his Maker says: “You ask me about the things that are to come, concerning my sons, and you command me concerning the work of my hands!
verses.zh: 耶和华―以色列的圣者，就是造就以色列的如此说：将来的事，你们可以问我；至于我的众子，并我手的工作，你们可以求我命定（原文是吩咐我）。

words.g: and + to mould into a form + +him/his/it

verses.en: I have made the earth, and created man on it. I, even my hands, have stretched out the heavens. I have commanded all their army.
verses.zh: 我造地，又造人在地上。我亲手铺张诸天；天上万象也是我所命定的。

words.g: a mass of persons , especially reg. organized forwar + +them/their

verses.en: I have raised him up in righteousness, and I will make all his ways straight. He shall build my city, and he shall let my exiles go free, not for price nor reward,” says the LORD of Armies.
verses.zh: 我凭公义兴起塞鲁士（原文是他），又要修直他一切道路。他必建造我的城，释放我被掳的民；不是为工价，也不是为赏赐。这是万军之耶和华说的。

words.g: a mass of persons , especially reg. organized forwar

verses.en: The LORD says: “The labor of Egypt, and the merchandise of Ethiopia, and the Sabeans, men of stature, will come over to you, and they will be yours. They will go after you. They shall come over in chains. They will bow down to you. They will make supplication to you: ‘Surely God is in you; and there is no one else. There is no other god.
verses.zh: 耶和华如此说：埃及劳碌得来的和古实的货物必归你；身量高大的西巴人必投降你，也要属你。他们必带着锁链过来随从你，又向你下拜，祈求你说：神真在你们中间，此外再没有别神；再没有别的神。

words.g: Mitsrajim, i.e. Upper and Lower Egypt
Cush , the name of a son of Ham
and + a Sebaite, or inhabitant of Seba
in + what leaps forth, i.e. flash of fire

verses.en: Most certainly you are a God who has hidden yourself, God of Israel, the Savior.’”
verses.zh: 救主―以色列的神啊，你实在是自隐的神。

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you
to be open, wide or free

verses.en: They will be disappointed, yes, confounded, all of them. Those who are makers of idols will go into confusion together.
verses.zh: 凡制造偶像的都必抱愧蒙羞，都要一同归于惭愧。

words.g: to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed

verses.en: Israel will be saved by the LORD with an everlasting salvation. You will not be disappointed nor confounded to ages everlasting.
verses.zh: 惟有以色列必蒙耶和华的拯救，得永远的救恩。你们必不蒙羞，也不抱愧，直到永世无尽。

words.g: to be open, wide or free
to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed

verses.en: For the LORD who created the heavens, the God who formed the earth and made it, who established it and didn’t create it a waste, who formed it to be inhabited says: “I am the LORD. There is no other.
verses.zh: 创造诸天的耶和华，制造成全大地的神，他创造坚定大地，并非使地荒凉，是要给人居住。他如此说：我是耶和华，再没有别神。

verses.en: I have not spoken in secret, in a place of the land of darkness. I didn’t say to the offspring of Jacob, ‘Seek me in vain.’ I, the LORD, speak righteousness. I declare things that are right.
verses.zh: 我没有在隐密黑暗之地说话；我没有对雅各的后裔说：你们寻求我是徒然的。我―耶和华所讲的是公义，所说的是正直。

verses.en: “Assemble yourselves and come. Draw near together, you who have escaped from the nations. Those have no knowledge who carry the wood of their engraved image, and pray to a god that can’t save.
verses.zh: 你们从列国逃脱的人，要一同聚集前来。那些抬着雕刻木偶、祷告不能救人之神的，毫无知识。

words.g: to be open, wide or free

verses.en: Declare and present it. Yes, let them take counsel together. Who has shown this from ancient time? Who has declared it of old? Haven’t I, the LORD? There is no other God besides me, a just God and a Savior. There is no one besides me.
verses.zh: 你们要述说陈明你们的理，让他们彼此商议。谁从古时指明？谁从上古述说？不是我―耶和华吗？除了我以外，再没有神；我是公义的神，又是救主；除了我以外，再没有别神。

words.g: and + to be open, wide or free

verses.en: “Look to me, and be saved, all the ends of the earth; for I am God, and there is no other.
verses.zh: 地极的人都当仰望我，就必得救；因为我是神，再没有别神。

words.g: and + to be open, wide or free

verses.en: I have sworn by myself. The word has gone out of my mouth in righteousness, and will not be revoked, that to me every knee shall bow, every tongue shall take an oath.
verses.zh: 我指着自己起誓，我口所出的话是凭公义，并不反回：万膝必向我跪拜；万口必凭我起誓。

words.g: from + the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +me/my

verses.en: They will say of me, ‘There is righteousness and strength only in the LORD.’” Even to him will men come. All those who raged against him will be disappointed.
verses.zh: 人论我说，公义、能力，惟独在乎耶和华；人都必归向他。凡向他发怒的必至蒙羞。

words.g: and + to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed

verses.en: All the offspring of Israel will be justified in the LORD, and will rejoice!
verses.zh: 以色列的后裔都必因耶和华得称为义，并要夸耀。

verses.en: Bel bows down. Nebo stoops. Their idols are carried by animals, and on the livestock. The things that you carried around are heavy loads, a burden for the weary.
verses.zh: 彼勒屈身，尼波弯腰；巴比伦的偶像驮在兽和牲畜上。他们所抬的如今成了重驮，使牲畜疲乏，

words.g: Bel, the Baal of the Babylonians
Nebo, the name of a Babylonian deity

verses.en: They stoop and they bow down together. They could not deliver the burden, but they have gone into captivity.
verses.zh: 都一同弯腰屈身，不能保全重驮，自己倒被掳去。

words.g: to be smooth, i.e.  to escape

verses.en: “Listen to me, house of Jacob, and all the remnant of the house of Israel, that have been carried from their birth, that have been carried from the womb.
verses.zh: 雅各家，以色列家一切余剩的要听我言：你们自从生下，就蒙我保抱，自从出胎，便蒙我怀搋。

words.g: the + to load, i.e. impose aburden

verses.en: Even to old age I am he, and even to gray hairs I will carry you. I have made, and I will bear. Yes, I will carry, and will deliver.
verses.zh: 直到你们年老，我仍这样；直到你们发白，我仍怀搋。我已造作，也必保抱；我必怀抱，也必拯救。

words.g: and + to be smooth, i.e.  to escape

verses.en: “To whom will you compare me, and consider my equal, and compare me, as if we were the same?
verses.zh: 你们将谁与我相比，与我同等，可以与我比较，使我们相同呢？

words.g: and + to liken, i.e.  to use figurative language + +me/my

verses.en: Some pour out gold from the bag, and weigh silver in the balance. They hire a goldsmith, and he makes it a god. They fall down— yes, they worship.
verses.zh: 那从囊中抓金子，用天平平银子的人，雇银匠制造神像，他们又俯伏，又叩拜。

words.g: the + probably to shake out, i.e.  to scatter profusely

verses.en: They bear it on their shoulder. They carry it, and set it in its place, and it stands there. It cannot move from its place. Yes, one may cry to it, yet it can not answer. It cannot save him out of his trouble.
verses.zh: 他们将神像抬起，扛在肩上，安置在定处，它就站立，不离本位；人呼求它，它不能答应，也不能救人脱离患难。

words.g: to be open, wide or free + +him/his/it

verses.en: “Remember this, and show yourselves men. Bring it to mind again, you transgressors.
verses.zh: 你们当想念这事，自己作大丈夫。悖逆的人哪，要心里思想。

words.g: and + to be a man, i.e. act in amanly way

verses.en: Remember the former things of old; for I am God, and there is no other. I am God, and there is none like me.
verses.zh: 你们要追念上古的事。因为我是神，并无别神；我是神，再没有能比我的。

words.g: a form of the prefix 'k-', but used separately  as + +me/my

verses.en: I declare the end from the beginning, and from ancient times things that are not yet done. I say: My counsel will stand, and I will do all that I please.
verses.zh: 我从起初指明末后的事，从古时言明未成的事，说：我的筹算必立定；凡我所喜悦的，我必成就。

verses.en: I call a ravenous bird from the east, the man of my counsel from a far country. Yes, I have spoken. I will also bring it to pass. I have planned. I will also do it.
verses.zh: 我召鸷鸟从东方来，召那成就我筹算的人从远方来。我已说出，也必成就；我已谋定，也必做成。

words.g: a hawk or other bird of prey

verses.en: Listen to me, you stubborn-hearted, who are far from righteousness!
verses.zh: 你们这些心中顽梗、远离公义的，当听我言。

verses.en: I bring my righteousness near. It is not far off, and my salvation will not wait. I will grant salvation to Zion, my glory to Israel.
verses.zh: 我使我的公义临近，必不远离。我的救恩必不迟延；我要为以色列―我的荣耀，在锡安施行救恩。

words.g: to widen , i.e.  recede or  remove
in + Tsijon , a mountain of Jerusalem

verses.en: “Come down and sit in the dust, virgin daughter of Babylon. Sit on the ground without a throne, daughter of the Chaldeans. For you will no longer be called tender and delicate.
verses.zh: 巴比伦的处女啊，下来坐在尘埃；迦勒底的闺女啊，没有宝座，要坐在地上；因为你不再称为柔弱娇嫩的。

words.g: Babel , including Babylonia and the Babylonian empire
a Kasdite, or descendant of Kesed

verses.en: Take the millstones and grind flour. Remove your veil, lift up your skirt, uncover your legs, and wade through the rivers.
verses.zh: 要用磨磨面，揭去帕子，脱去长衣，露腿蹚河。

words.g: to strip off, i.e. generally to make naked

verses.en: Your nakedness will be uncovered. Yes, your shame will be seen. I will take vengeance, and will spare no one.”
verses.zh: 你的下体必被露出；你的丑陋必被看见。我要报仇，谁也不宽容。

words.g: to impinge, by accident or violence

verses.en: Our Redeemer, the LORD of Armies is his name, is the Holy One of Israel.
verses.zh: 我们救赎主的名是万军之耶和华―以色列的圣者。

words.g: to be the next of kin + +us/our
a mass of persons , especially reg. organized forwar

verses.en: “Sit in silence, and go into darkness, daughter of the Chaldeans. For you shall no longer be called the mistress of kingdoms.
verses.zh: 迦勒底的闺女啊，你要默然静坐，进入暗中，因为你不再称为列国的主母。

words.g: a Kasdite, or descendant of Kesed
dominion, i.e.  the estate  or  the country

verses.en: I was angry with my people. I profaned my inheritance and gave them into your hand. You showed them no mercy. You laid a very heavy yoke on the aged.
verses.zh: 我向我的百姓发怒，使我的产业被亵渎，将他们交在你手中，你毫不怜悯他们，把极重的轭加在老年人身上。

words.g: to crack off, i.e.  burst out in rage

verses.en: You said, ‘I will be a princess forever,’ so that you didn’t lay these things to your heart, nor did you remember the results.
verses.zh: 你自己说：我必永为主母，所以你不将这事放在心上，也不思想这事的结局。

verses.en: “Now therefore hear this, you who are given to pleasures, who sit securely, who say in your heart, ‘I am, and there is no one else besides me. I won’t sit as a widow, neither will I know the loss of children.’
verses.zh: 你这专好宴乐、安然居住的，现在当听这话。你心中说：惟有我，除我以外再没有别的。我必不致寡居，也不遭丧子之事。

verses.en: But these two things will come to you in a moment in one day: the loss of children and widowhood. They will come on you in their full measure, in the multitude of your sorceries, and the great abundance of your enchantments.
verses.zh: 哪知，丧子、寡居这两件事在一日转眼之间必临到你；正在你多行邪术、广施符咒的时候，这两件事必全然临到你身上。

words.g: a wink , i.e. a very short space of time

verses.en: For you have trusted in your wickedness. You have said, ‘No one sees me.’ Your wisdom and your knowledge has perverted you. You have said in your heart, ‘I am, and there is no one else besides me.’
verses.zh: 你素来倚仗自己的恶行，说：无人看见我。你的智慧聪明使你偏邪，并且你心里说：惟有我，除我以外再没有别的。

verses.en: Therefore disaster will come on you. You won’t know when it dawns. Mischief will fall on you. You won’t be able to put it away. Desolation will come on you suddenly, which you don’t understand.
verses.zh: 因此，祸患要临到你身，你不知何时发现（或译：如何驱逐）；灾害落在你身上，你也不能除掉；所不知道的毁灭也必忽然临到你身。

verses.en: “Stand now with your enchantments and with the multitude of your sorceries, in which you have labored from your youth, as if you might profit, as if you might prevail.
verses.zh: 站起来吧！用你从幼年劳神施行的符咒和你许多的邪术；或者可得益处，或者可得强胜。

words.g: from + youth, the state  or the persons + +you/your

verses.en: You are wearied in the multitude of your counsels. Now let the astrologers, the stargazers, and the monthly prognosticators stand up and save you from the things that will happen to you.
verses.zh: 你筹划太多，以致疲倦。让那些观天象的，看星宿的，在月朔说预言的，都站起来，救你脱离所要临到你的事。

words.g: and + to be open, wide or free + +you/your

verses.en: Behold, they are like stubble. The fire will burn them. They won’t deliver themselves from the power of the flame. It won’t be a coal to warm at or a fire to sit by.
verses.zh: 他们要像碎秸被火焚烧，不能救自己脱离火焰之力；这火并非可烤的炭火，也不是可以坐在其前的火。

verses.en: The things that you labored in will be like this: those who have trafficked with you from your youth will each wander in his own way. There will be no one to save you.
verses.zh: 你所劳神的事都要这样与你无益；从幼年与你贸易的也都各奔各乡，无人救你。

words.g: from + youth, the state  or the persons + +you/your
to vacillate, i.e. reel or stray
to be open, wide or free + +you/your

verses.en: “Hear this, house of Jacob, you who are called by the name of Israel, and have come out of the waters of Judah. You swear by the LORD’s name, and make mention of the God of Israel, but not in truth, nor in righteousness—
verses.zh: 雅各家，称为以色列名下，从犹大水源出来的，当听我言！你们指着耶和华的名起誓，提说以色列的神，却不凭诚实，不凭公义。

words.g: Jehudah , the name of five Israelites
the + to seven oneself, i.e. swear

verses.en: for they call themselves citizens of the holy city, and rely on the God of Israel; the LORD of Armies is his name.
verses.zh: 他们自称为圣城的人，所倚靠的是名为万军之耶和华―以色列的神。

words.g: a mass of persons , especially reg. organized forwar

verses.en: I have declared the former things from of old. Yes, they went out of my mouth, and I revealed them. I did them suddenly, and they happened.
verses.zh: 主说：早先的事，我从古时说明，已经出了我的口，也是我所指示的；我忽然行做，事便成就。

words.g: and + from + the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +me/my

verses.en: Because I knew that you are obstinate, and your neck is an iron sinew, and your brow bronze;
verses.zh: 因为我素来知道你是顽梗的―你的颈项是铁的；你的额是铜的。

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you
the nape or back of the neck + +you/your

verses.en: therefore I have declared it to you from of old; before it came to pass I showed it to you; lest you should say, ‘My idol has done them. My engraved image and my molten image has commanded them.’
verses.zh: 所以，我从古时将这事给你说明，在未成以先指示你，免得你说：这些事是我的偶像所行的，是我雕刻的偶像和我铸造的偶像所命定的。

verses.en: You have heard it. Now see all this. And you, won’t you declare it? “I have shown you new things from this time, even hidden things, which you have not known.
verses.zh: 你已经听见，现在要看见这一切；你不说明吗？从今以后，我将新事，就是你所不知道的隐密事指示你。

words.g: and + thou and thee, or  ye and you
and + to guard, in a good sense  or a bad one

verses.en: They are created now, and not from of old. Before today, you didn’t hear them, lest you should say, ‘Behold, I knew them.’
verses.zh: 这事是现今造的，并非从古就有；在今日以先，你也未曾听见，免得你说：这事我早已知道了。

verses.en: Yes, you didn’t hear. Yes, you didn’t know. Yes, from of old your ear was not opened, for I knew that you dealt very treacherously, and were called a transgressor from the womb.
verses.zh: 你未曾听见，未曾知道；你的耳朵从来未曾开通。我原知道你行事极其诡诈，你自从出胎以来，便称为悖逆的。

words.g: and + to break away , i.e. trespass

verses.en: For my name’s sake, I will defer my anger, and for my praise, I hold it back for you so that I don’t cut you off.
verses.zh: 我为我的名暂且忍怒，为我的颂赞向你容忍，不将你剪除。

words.g: to + a failure of, i.e.  not

verses.en: Behold, I have refined you, but not as silver. I have chosen you in the furnace of affliction.
verses.zh: 我熬炼你，却不像熬炼银子；你在苦难的炉中，我拣选你。

verses.en: For my own sake, for my own sake, I will do it; for how would my name be profaned? I will not give my glory to another.
verses.zh: 我为自己的缘故必行这事，我焉能使我的名被亵渎？我必不将我的荣耀归给假神。

words.g: and + weight, but only figuratively in a good sense + +me/my

verses.en: “Listen to me, O Jacob, and Israel my called: I am he. I am the first. I am also the last.
verses.zh: 雅各―我所选召的以色列啊，当听我言：我是耶和华，我是首先的，也是末后的。

verses.en: Yes, my hand has laid the foundation of the earth, and my right hand has spread out the heavens. when I call to them, they stand up together.
verses.zh: 我手立了地的根基；我右手铺张诸天；我一招呼便都立住。

verses.en: “Assemble yourselves, all of you, and hear! Who among them has declared these things? He whom the LORD loves will do what he likes to Babylon, and his arm will be against the Chaldeans.
verses.zh: 你们都当聚集而听，他们（或译：偶像）内中谁说过这些事？耶和华所爱的人必向巴比伦行他所喜悦的事；他的膀臂也要加在迦勒底人身上。

words.g: in + Babel , including Babylonia and the Babylonian empire
and + the arm , or  the foreleg + +him/his/it
a Kasdite, or descendant of Kesed

verses.en: I, even I, have spoken. Yes, I have called him. I have brought him and he shall make his way prosperous.
verses.zh: 惟有我曾说过，我又选召他，领他来，他的道路就必亨通。

words.g: and + to push forward, in various senses

verses.en: “Come near to me and hear this: “From the beginning I have not spoken in secret; from the time that it happened, I was there.” Now the Lord GOD has sent me with his Spirit.
verses.zh: 你们要就近我来听这话：我从起头并未曾在隐密处说话；自从有这事，我就在那里。现在，主耶和华差遣我和他的灵来（或译：耶和华和他的灵差遣我来）。

verses.en: The LORD, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel, says: “I am the LORD your God, who teaches you to profit, who leads you by the way that you should go.
verses.zh: 耶和华―你的救赎主，以色列的圣者如此说：我是耶和华―你的神，教训你，使你得益处，引导你所当行的路。

words.g: to be the next of kin + +you/your

verses.en: Oh that you had listened to my commandments! Then your peace would have been like a river and your righteousness like the waves of the sea.
verses.zh: 甚愿你素来听从我的命令！你的平安就如河水；你的公义就如海浪。

words.g: to prick up the ears, i.e. hearken
to + a command, whether human or divine + +me/my

verses.en: Your offspring also would have been as the sand and the descendants of your body like its grains. His name would not be cut off nor destroyed from before me.”
verses.zh: 你的后裔也必多如海沙；你腹中所生的也必多如沙粒。他的名在我面前必不剪除，也不灭绝。

verses.en: Leave Babylon! Flee from the Chaldeans! With the sound of joyful shouting announce this, tell it even to the end of the earth; say, “The LORD has redeemed his servant Jacob!”
verses.zh: 你们要从巴比伦出来，从迦勒底人中逃脱，以欢呼的声音传扬说：耶和华救赎了他的仆人雅各！你们要将这事宣扬到地极。

words.g: from + Babel , including Babylonia and the Babylonian empire
from + a Kasdite, or descendant of Kesed
to be the next of kin

verses.en: They didn’t thirst when he led them through the deserts. He caused the waters to flow out of the rock for them. He also split the rock and the waters gushed out.
verses.zh: 耶和华引导他们经过沙漠。他们并不干渴；他为他们使水从磐石而流，分裂磐石，水就涌出。

words.g: to drip, or shed by trickling
and + to flow freely , i.e.  to have a  flux

verses.en: “There is no peace”, says the LORD, “for the wicked.”
verses.zh: 耶和华说：恶人必不得平安！

verses.en: Listen, islands, to me. Listen, you peoples, from afar: the LORD has called me from the womb; from the inside of my mother, he has mentioned my name.
verses.zh: 众海岛啊，当听我言！远方的众民哪，留心而听！自我出胎，耶和华就选召我；自出母腹，他就提我的名。

words.g: and + to prick up the ears, i.e. hearken

verses.en: He has made my mouth like a sharp sword. He has hidden me in the shadow of his hand. He has made me a polished shaft. He has kept me close in his quiver.
verses.zh: 他使我的口如快刀，将我藏在他手荫之下；又使我成为磨亮的箭，将我藏在他箭袋之中；

words.g: the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +me/my

verses.en: He said to me, “You are my servant, Israel, in whom I will be glorified.”
verses.zh: 对我说：你是我的仆人以色列；我必因你得荣耀。

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: But I said, “I have labored in vain. I have spent my strength in vain for nothing; yet surely the justice due to me is with the LORD, and my reward with my God.”
verses.zh: 我却说：我劳碌是徒然；我尽力是虚无虚空。然而，我当得的理必在耶和华那里；我的赏赐必在我神那里。

words.g: to end, whether intransitive  or transitived

verses.en: Now the LORD, he who formed me from the womb to be his servant, says to bring Jacob again to him, and to gather Israel to him, for I am honorable in the LORD’s eyes, and my God has become my strength.
verses.zh: 耶和华从我出胎，造就我作他的仆人，要使雅各归向他，使以色列到他那里聚集。原来耶和华看我为尊贵；我的神也成为我的力量。

verses.en: Indeed, he says, “It is too light a thing that you should be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob, and to restore the preserved of Israel. I will also give you as a light to the nations, that you may be my salvation to the end of the earth.”
verses.zh: 现在他说：你作我的仆人，使雅各众支派复兴，使以色列中得保全的归回尚为小事，我还要使你作外邦人的光，叫你施行我的救恩，直到地极。

words.g: and + to guard, in a good sense  or a bad one

verses.en: The LORD, the Redeemer of Israel, and his Holy One, says to him whom man despises, to him whom the nation abhors, to a servant of rulers: “Kings shall see and rise up, princes, and they shall worship, because of the LORD who is faithful, even the Holy One of Israel, who has chosen you.”
verses.zh: 救赎主―以色列的圣者耶和华对那被人所藐视、本国所憎恶、官长所虐待的如此说：君王要看见就站起，首领也要下拜；都因信实的耶和华，就是拣选你―以色列的圣者。

words.g: to be the next of kin

verses.en: The LORD says, “I have answered you in an acceptable time. I have helped you in a day of salvation. I will preserve you and give you for a covenant of the people, to raise up the land, to make them inherit the desolate heritage,
verses.zh: 耶和华如此说：在悦纳的时候，我应允了你；在拯救的日子，我济助了你。我要保护你，使你作众民的中保（中保：原文是约）；复兴遍地，使人承受荒凉之地为业。

words.g: to surround, i.e. protect or aid + +you/your
and + to guard, in a good sense  or a bad one + +you/your
to + to inherit  mode of descent), or  to occupy
to stun , i.e. devastate or  stupefy

verses.en: saying to those who are bound, ‘Come out!’; to those who are in darkness, ‘Show yourselves!’ “They shall feed along the paths, and their pasture shall be on all treeless heights.
verses.zh: 对那被捆绑的人说：出来吧！对那在黑暗的人说：显露吧！他们在路上必得饮食，在一切净光的高处必有食物。

verses.en: They shall not hunger nor thirst; neither shall the heat nor sun strike them, for he who has mercy on them will lead them. He will guide them by springs of water.
verses.zh: 不饥不渴，炎热和烈日必不伤害他们；因为怜恤他们的必引导他们，领他们到水泉旁边。

verses.en: I will make all my mountains a road, and my highways shall be exalted.
verses.zh: 我必使我的众山成为大道；我的大路也被修高。

words.g: and + a thoroughfare , literally or figuratively + +me/my
to be high actively, to rise or raise

verses.en: Behold, these shall come from afar, and behold, these from the north and from the west, and these from the land of Sinim.”
verses.zh: 看哪，这些从远方来；这些从北方、从西方来；这些从秦（原文是希尼）国来。

verses.en: Sing, heavens, and be joyful, earth! Break out into singing, mountains! For the LORD has comforted his people, and will have compassion on his afflicted.
verses.zh: 诸天哪，应当欢呼！大地啊，应当快乐！众山哪，应当发声歌唱！因为耶和华已经安慰他的百姓，也要怜恤他困苦之民。

words.g: and + to spin round , i.e. usually rejoice
and + depressed, in mind or circumstances + +him/his/it

verses.en: But Zion said, “The LORD has forsaken me, and the Lord has forgotten me.”
verses.zh: 锡安说：耶和华离弃了我；主忘记了我。

words.g: to mislay, i.e. to be oblivious of + +me/my

verses.en: “Can a woman forget her nursing child, that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb? Yes, these may forget, yet I will not forget you!
verses.zh: 妇人焉能忘记她吃奶的婴孩，不怜恤她所生的儿子？即或有忘记的，我却不忘记你。

words.g: (question) + to mislay, i.e. to be oblivious of
to mislay, i.e. to be oblivious of
to mislay, i.e. to be oblivious of + +you/your

verses.en: Behold, I have engraved you on the palms of my hands. Your walls are continually before me.
verses.zh: 看哪，我将你铭刻在我掌上；你的墙垣常在我眼前。

verses.en: Your children hurry. Your destroyers and those who devastated you will leave you.
verses.zh: 你的儿女必急速归回；毁坏你的，使你荒废的，必都离你出去，

words.g: to be liquid or flow easily, i.e
to pull down or in pieces, break + +you/your
and + to parch  i.e.  to desolate, destroy + +you/your

verses.en: Lift up your eyes all around, and see: all these gather themselves together, and come to you. As I live,” says the LORD, “you shall surely clothe yourself with them all as with an ornament, and dress yourself with them, like a bride.
verses.zh: 你举目向四方观看；他们都聚集来到你这里。耶和华说：我指着我的永生起誓：你必要以他们为妆饰佩戴，以他们为华带束腰，像新妇一样。

words.g: and + to tie, physically  or mentally + +them/their

verses.en: “For, as for your waste and your desolate places, and your land that has been destroyed, surely now that land will be too small for the inhabitants, and those who swallowed you up will be far away.
verses.zh: 至于你荒废凄凉之处，并你被毁坏之地，现今众民居住必显为太窄；吞灭你的必离你遥远。

words.g: and + to stun , i.e. devastate or  stupefy + +you/your
and + to widen , i.e.  recede or  remove

verses.en: The children of your bereavement will say in your ears, ‘This place is too small for me. Give me a place to live in.’
verses.zh: 你必听见丧子之后所生的儿女说：这地方我居住太窄，求你给我地方居住。

verses.en: Then you will say in your heart, ‘Who has conceived these for me, since I have been bereaved of my children and am alone, an exile, and wandering back and forth? Who has brought these up? Behold, I was left alone. Where were these?’”
verses.zh: 那时你心里必说：我既丧子独居，是被掳的，漂流在外。谁给我生这些？谁将这些养大呢？撇下我一人独居的时候，这些在哪里呢？

words.g: to swell up, i.e. be  redundant

verses.en: The Lord GOD says, “Behold, I will lift up my hand to the nations, and lift up my banner to the peoples. They shall bring your sons in their bosom, and your daughters shall be carried on their shoulders.
verses.zh: 主耶和华如此说：我必向列国举手，向万民竖立大旗；他们必将你的众子怀中抱来，将你的众女肩上扛来。

words.g: to be high actively, to rise or raise

verses.en: Kings shall be your foster fathers, and their queens your nursing mothers. They will bow down to you with their faces to the earth, and lick the dust of your feet. Then you will know that I am the LORD; and those who wait for me won’t be disappointed.”
verses.zh: 列王必作你的养父；王后必作你的乳母。他们必将脸伏地，向你下拜，并舔你脚上的尘土。你便知道我是耶和华；等候我的必不致羞愧。

words.g: and + a mistress, i.e. female noble + +them/their
to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed

verses.en: Shall the plunder be taken from the mighty, or the lawful captives be delivered?
verses.zh: 勇士抢去的岂能夺回？该掳掠的岂能解救吗？

words.g: and + used very widely as demonstrative, lo!
to be smooth, i.e.  to escape

verses.en: But the LORD says, “Even the captives of the mighty shall be taken away, and the plunder retrieved from the fierce, for I will contend with him who contends with you and I will save your children.
verses.zh: 但耶和华如此说：就是勇士所掳掠的，也可以夺回；强暴人所抢的，也可以解救。与你相争的，我必与他相争；我要拯救你的儿女。

words.g: to be smooth, i.e.  to escape
to be open, wide or free

verses.en: I will feed those who oppress you with their own flesh; and they will be drunk on their own blood, as with sweet wine. Then all flesh shall know that I, the LORD, am your Savior and your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.”
verses.zh: 并且我必使那欺压你的吃自己的肉，也要以自己的血喝醉，好像喝甜酒一样。凡有血气的必都知道我―耶和华是你的救主，是你的救赎主，是雅各的大能者。

words.g: and + like + must or fresh grape-juice
to be open, wide or free + +you/your
and + to be the next of kin + +you/your

verses.en: The LORD says, “Where is the bill of your mother’s divorce, with which I have put her away? Or to which of my creditors have I sold you? Behold, you were sold for your iniquities, and your mother was put away for your transgressions.
verses.zh: 耶和华如此说：我休你们的母亲，休书在哪里呢？我将你们卖给我哪一个债主呢？你们被卖，是因你们的罪孽；你们的母亲被休，是因你们的过犯。

words.g: from + to lend or  borrow on security or interest + +me/my

verses.en: Why, when I came, was there no one? When I called, why was there no one to answer? Is my hand shortened at all, that it can’t redeem? Or have I no power to deliver? Behold, at my rebuke I dry up the sea. I make the rivers a wilderness. Their fish stink because there is no water, and die of thirst.
verses.zh: 我来的时候，为何无人等候呢？我呼唤的时候，为何无人答应呢？我的膀臂岂是缩短、不能救赎吗？我岂无拯救之力吗？看哪，我一斥责，海就干了；我使江河变为旷野；其中的鱼因无水腥臭，干渴而死。

words.g: and + used very widely as demonstrative, lo!
to parch  i.e.  to desolate, destroy

verses.en: I clothe the heavens with blackness. I make sackcloth their covering.”
verses.zh: 我使诸天以黑暗为衣服，以麻布为遮盖。

verses.en: The Lord GOD has given me the tongue of those who are taught, that I may know how to sustain with words him who is weary. He awakens morning by morning, he awakens my ear to hear as those who are taught.
verses.zh: 主耶和华赐我受教者的舌头，使我知道怎样用言语扶助疲乏的人。主每早晨提醒，提醒我的耳朵，使我能听，像受教者一样。

verses.en: The Lord GOD has opened my ear. I was not rebellious. I have not turned back.
verses.zh: 主耶和华开通我的耳朵；我并没有违背，也没有退后。

words.g: to flinch, i.e.  to go back

verses.en: I gave my back to those who beat me, and my cheeks to those who plucked off the hair. I didn’t hide my face from shame and spitting.
verses.zh: 人打我的背，我任他打；人拔我腮颊的胡须，我由他拔；人辱我，吐我，我并不掩面。

verses.en: For the Lord GOD will help me. Therefore I have not been confounded. Therefore I have set my face like a flint, and I know that I won’t be disappointed.
verses.zh: 主耶和华必帮助我，所以我不抱愧。我硬着脸面好像坚石；我也知道我必不致蒙羞。

words.g: to surround, i.e. protect or aid
to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed

verses.en: He who justifies me is near. Who will bring charges against me? Let us stand up together. Who is my adversary? Let him come near to me.
verses.zh: 称我为义的与我相近；谁与我争论，可以与我一同站立；谁与我作对，可以就近我来。

verses.en: Behold, the Lord GOD will help me! Who is he who will condemn me? Behold, they will all grow old like a garment. The moths will eat them up.
verses.zh: 主耶和华要帮助我；谁能定我有罪呢？他们都像衣服渐渐旧了，为蛀虫所咬。

words.g: to surround, i.e. protect or aid

verses.en: Who among you fears the LORD and obeys the voice of his servant? He who walks in darkness and has no light, let him trust in the LORD’s name, and rely on his God.
verses.zh: 你们中间谁是敬畏耶和华、听从他仆人之话的？这人行在暗中，没有亮光。当倚靠耶和华的名，仗赖自己的神。

verses.en: Behold, all you who kindle a fire, who adorn yourselves with torches around yourselves, walk in the flame of your fire, and among the torches that you have kindled. You will have this from my hand: you will lie down in sorrow.
verses.zh: 凡你们点火，用火把围绕自己的可以行在你们的火焰里，并你们所点的火把中。这是我手所定的：你们必躺在悲惨之中。

words.g: what leaps forth, i.e. flash of fire
and + in + what leaps forth, i.e. flash of fire

verses.en: “Listen to me, you who follow after righteousness, you who seek the LORD. Look to the rock you were cut from, and to the quarry you were dug from.
verses.zh: 你们这追求公义、寻求耶和华的，当听我言！你们要追想被凿而出的磐石，被挖而出的岩穴。

verses.en: Look to Abraham your father, and to Sarah who bore you; for when he was but one I called him, I blessed him, and made him many.
verses.zh: 要追想你们的祖宗亚伯拉罕和生养你们的撒拉；因为亚伯拉罕独自一人的时候，我选召他，赐福与他，使他人数增多。

words.g: Abraham, the later name of Abram
father, in a literal and immediate + +you/your
to twist or whirl , i.e.  to dance + +you/your

verses.en: For the LORD has comforted Zion. He has comforted all her waste places, and has made her wilderness like Eden, and her desert like the garden of the LORD. Joy and gladness will be found in them, thanksgiving, and the voice of melody.
verses.zh: 耶和华已经安慰锡安和锡安一切的荒场，使旷野像伊甸，使沙漠像耶和华的园囿；在其中必有欢喜、快乐、感谢，和歌唱的声音。

words.g: like + Eden, the region of Adam's home
a musical piece or song to be accompanied by an instrument

verses.en: “Listen to me, my people; and hear me, my nation, for a law will go out from me, and I will establish my justice for a light to the peoples.
verses.zh: 我的百姓啊，要向我留心；我的国民哪，要向我侧耳；因为训诲必从我而出；我必坚定我的公理为万民之光。

words.g: to prick up the ears, i.e. hearken
to broaden out the ear , i.e.  to listen

verses.en: My righteousness is near. My salvation has gone out, and my arms will judge the peoples. The islands will wait for me, and they will trust my arm.
verses.zh: 我的公义临近；我的救恩发出。我的膀臂要审判万民；海岛都要等候我，倚赖我的膀臂。

words.g: and + the arm , or  the foreleg + +me/my

verses.en: Lift up your eyes to the heavens, and look at the earth beneath; for the heavens will vanish away like smoke, and the earth will wear out like a garment. Its inhabitants will die in the same way, but my salvation will be forever, and my righteousness will not be abolished.
verses.zh: 你们要向天举目，观看下地；因为天必像烟云消散，地必如衣服渐渐旧了；其上的居民也要如此死亡（如此死亡：或译像蠓虫死亡）。惟有我的救恩永远长存；我的公义也不废掉。

words.g: to rub to pieces or pulverize
a form of the prefix 'k-', but used separately  as

verses.en: “Listen to me, you who know righteousness, the people in whose heart is my law. Don’t fear the reproach of men, and don’t be dismayed at their insults.
verses.zh: 知道公义、将我训诲存在心中的民，要听我言！不要怕人的辱骂，也不要因人的毁谤惊惶。

verses.en: For the moth will eat them up like a garment, and the worm will eat them like wool; but my righteousness will be forever, and my salvation to all generations.”
verses.zh: 因为蛀虫必咬他们，好像咬衣服；虫子必咬他们，如同咬羊绒。惟有我的公义永远长存，我的救恩直到万代。

verses.en: Awake, awake, put on strength, arm of the LORD! Awake, as in the days of old, the generations of ancient times. Isn’t it you who cut Rahab in pieces, who pierced the monster?
verses.zh: 耶和华的膀臂啊，兴起！兴起！以能力为衣穿上，像古时的年日、上古的世代兴起一样。从前砍碎拉哈伯、刺透大鱼的，不是你吗？

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you
a marine or land monster, i.e. sea-serpent or jackal

verses.en: Isn’t it you who dried up the sea, the waters of the great deep; who made the depths of the sea a way for the redeemed to pass over?
verses.zh: 使海与深渊的水干涸、使海的深处变为赎民经过之路的，不是你吗？

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you
the + to parch  i.e.  to desolate, destroy
to be the next of kin

verses.en: Those ransomed by the LORD will return, and come with singing to Zion. Everlasting joy shall be on their heads. They will obtain gladness and joy. Sorrow and sighing shall flee away.
verses.zh: 耶和华救赎的民必归回，歌唱来到锡安；永乐必归到他们的头上。他们必得着欢喜快乐；忧愁叹息尽都逃避。

verses.en: “I, even I, am he who comforts you. Who are you, that you are afraid of man who shall die, and of the son of man who will be made as grass?
verses.zh: 惟有我，是安慰你们的。你是谁，竟怕那必死的人？怕那要变如草的世人？

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: Have you forgotten the LORD your Maker, who stretched out the heavens, and laid the foundations of the earth? Do you live in fear continually all day because of the fury of the oppressor, when he prepares to destroy? Where is the fury of the oppressor?
verses.zh: 却忘记铺张诸天、立定地基、创造你的耶和华？又因欺压者图谋毁灭要发的暴怒，整天害怕，其实那欺压者的暴怒在哪里呢？

words.g: and + to mislay, i.e. to be oblivious of

verses.en: The captive exile will speedily be freed. He will not die and go down into the pit. His bread won’t fail.
verses.zh: 被掳去的快得释放，必不死而下坑；他的食物也不致缺乏。

words.g: to be liquid or flow easily, i.e

verses.en: For I am the LORD your God, who stirs up the sea so that its waves roar. the LORD of Armies is his name.
verses.zh: 我是耶和华―你的神―搅动大海，使海中的波浪匉訇―万军之耶和华是我的名。

words.g: and + to make a loud sound
a mass of persons , especially reg. organized forwar

verses.en: I have put my words in your mouth and have covered you in the shadow of my hand, that I may plant the heavens, and lay the foundations of the earth, and tell Zion, ‘You are my people.’”
verses.zh: 我将我的话传给你，用我的手影遮蔽你，为要栽定诸天，立定地基，又对锡安说：你是我的百姓。

words.g: in + the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +you/your
to + to strike in, i.e. fix
to + Tsijon , a mountain of Jerusalem
thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: Awake, awake! Stand up, Jerusalem, you who have drunk from the LORD’s hand the cup of his wrath. You have drunken the bowl of the cup of staggering, and drained it.
verses.zh: 耶路撒冷啊，兴起！兴起！站起来！你从耶和华手中喝了他忿怒之杯，喝了那使人东倒西歪的爵，以致喝尽。

words.g: Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine

verses.en: There is no one to guide her among all the sons to whom she has given birth; and there is no one who takes her by the hand among all the sons whom she has brought up.
verses.zh: 她所生育的诸子中，没有一个引导她的；她所养大的诸子中，没有一个搀扶她的。

verses.en: These two things have happened to you— who will grieve with you?— desolation and destruction, and famine and the sword. How can I comfort you?
verses.zh: 荒凉、毁灭、饥荒、刀兵，这几样临到你，谁为你举哀？我如何能安慰你呢？

words.g: to encounter, whether accidentally or in a hostile manner + +you/your

verses.en: Your sons have fainted. They lie at the head of all the streets, like an antelope in a net. They are full of the LORD’s wrath, the rebuke of your God.
verses.zh: 你的众子发昏，在各市口上躺卧，好像黄羊在网罗之中，都满了耶和华的忿怒―你神的斥责。

verses.en: Therefore now hear this, you afflicted, and drunken, but not with wine:
verses.zh: 因此，你这困苦却非因酒而醉的，要听我言。

verses.en: Your Lord GOD, your God who pleads the cause of his people, says, “Behold, I have taken out of your hand the cup of staggering, even the bowl of the cup of my wrath. You will not drink it any more.
verses.zh: 你的主耶和华―就是为他百姓辨屈的神如此说：看哪，我已将那使人东倒西歪的杯，就是我忿怒的爵，从你手中接过来；你必不致再喝。

verses.en: I will put it into the hand of those who afflict you, who have said to your soul, ‘Bow down, that we may walk over you;’ and you have laid your back as the ground, like a street to those who walk over.”
verses.zh: 我必将这杯递在苦待你的人手中；他们曾对你说：你屈身，由我们践踏过去吧！你便以背为地，好像街市，任人经过。

words.g: and + like + separate by awall, i.e. outside

verses.en: Awake, awake! Put on your strength, Zion. Put on your beautiful garments, Jerusalem, the holy city, for from now on the uncircumcised and the unclean will no more come into you.
verses.zh: 锡安哪，兴起！兴起！披上你的能力！圣城耶路撒冷啊，穿上你华美的衣服！因为从今以后，未受割礼、不洁净的必不再进入你中间。

words.g: Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine
and + foul in a religious sense

verses.en: Shake yourself from the dust! Arise, sit up, Jerusalem! Release yourself from the bonds of your neck, captive daughter of Zion!
verses.zh: 耶路撒冷啊，要抖下尘土！起来坐在位上！锡安被掳的居民（原文是女子）哪，要解开你颈项的锁链！

words.g: Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine

verses.en: For the LORD says, “You were sold for nothing; and you will be redeemed without money.”
verses.zh: 耶和华如此说：「你们是无价被卖的，也必无银被赎。

words.g: to be the next of kin

verses.en: For the Lord GOD says: “My people went down at the first into Egypt to live there; and the Assyrian has oppressed them without cause.
verses.zh: 主耶和华如此说：起先我的百姓下到埃及，在那里寄居，又有亚述人无故欺压他们。

words.g: Mitsrajim, i.e. Upper and Lower Egypt
to + to turn aside from the road , i.e. sojourn
and + Ashshur, the second son of Shem

verses.en: “Now therefore, what do I do here,” says the LORD, “seeing that my people are taken away for nothing? Those who rule over them mock,” says the LORD, “and my name is blasphemed continually all day long.
verses.zh: 耶和华说：我的百姓既是无价被掳去，如今我在这里做甚么呢？耶和华说：辖制他们的人呼叫，我的名整天受亵渎。

words.g: this place , i.e. here or hence

verses.en: Therefore my people shall know my name. Therefore they shall know in that day that I am he who speaks. Behold, it is I.”
verses.zh: 所以，我的百姓必知道我的名；到那日他们必知道说这话的就是我。看哪，是我！」

verses.en: How beautiful on the mountains are the feet of him who brings good news, who publishes peace, who brings good news, who proclaims salvation, who says to Zion, “Your God reigns!”
verses.zh: 那报佳音，传平安，报好信，传救恩的，对锡安说：你的神作王了！这人的脚登山何等佳美！

words.g: to be at home, i.e.  to be pleasant
to be fresh, i.e. full  cheerful)
to be fresh, i.e. full  cheerful)
to + Tsijon , a mountain of Jerusalem

verses.en: Your watchmen lift up their voice. Together they sing; for they shall see eye to eye when the LORD returns to Zion.
verses.zh: 听啊，你守望之人的声音，他们扬起声来，一同歌唱；因为耶和华归回锡安的时候，他们必亲眼看见。

words.g: to lean forward, i.e. to peer into the distance + +you/your

verses.en: Break out into joy! Sing together, you waste places of Jerusalem; for the LORD has comforted his people. He has redeemed Jerusalem.
verses.zh: 耶路撒冷的荒场啊，要发起欢声，一同歌唱；因为耶和华安慰了他的百姓，救赎了耶路撒冷。

words.g: Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine
to be the next of kin
Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine

verses.en: The LORD has made his holy arm bare in the eyes of all the nations. All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
verses.zh: 耶和华在万国眼前露出圣臂；地极的人都看见我们神的救恩了。

words.g: to strip off, i.e. generally to make naked

verses.en: Depart! Depart! Go out from there! Touch no unclean thing! Go out from among her! Cleanse yourselves, you who carry the LORD’s vessels.
verses.zh: 你们离开吧！离开吧！从巴比伦出来。不要沾不洁净的物；要从其中出来。你们扛抬耶和华器皿的人哪，务要自洁。

verses.en: For you shall not go out in haste, neither shall you go by flight; for the LORD will go before you, and the God of Israel will be your rear guard.
verses.zh: 你们出来必不致急忙，也不致奔逃。因为，耶和华必在你们前头行；以色列的神必作你们的后盾。

words.g: and + to gather for any purpose + +you/your

verses.en: Behold, my servant will deal wisely. He will be exalted and lifted up, and will be very high.
verses.zh: 我的仆人行事必有智慧（或译：行事通达），必被高举上升，且成为至高。

words.g: to be  circumspect and hence, intelligent
to be high actively, to rise or raise
and + to soar, i.e. be lofty

verses.en: Just as many were astonished at you— his appearance was marred more than any man, and his form more than the sons of men—
verses.zh: 许多人因他（原文是你）惊奇；他的面貌比别人憔悴；他的形容比世人枯槁。

words.g: to stun , i.e. devastate or  stupefy
and + outline, i.e. figure or appearance + +him/his/it

verses.en: so he will cleanse many nations. Kings will shut their mouths at him; for they will see that which had not been told them, and they will understand that which they had not heard.
verses.zh: 这样，他必洗净（或译：鼓动）许多国民；君王要向他闭口。因所未曾传与他们的，他们必看见；未曾听见的，他们要明白。

words.g: the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +them/their
to score with a mark as a tally or record, i.e.  to inscribe

verses.en: Who has believed our message? To whom has the LORD’s arm been revealed?
verses.zh: 我们所传的（或译：所传与我们的）有谁信呢？耶和华的膀臂向谁显露呢？

words.g: to + something heard, i.e. an announcement + +us/our
and + the arm , or  the foreleg

verses.en: For he grew up before him as a tender plant, and as a root out of dry ground. He has no good looks or majesty. When we see him, there is no beauty that we should desire him.
verses.zh: 他在耶和华面前生长如嫩芽，像根出于干地。他无佳形美容；我们看见他的时候，也无美貌使我们羡慕他。

verses.en: He was despised and rejected by men, a man of suffering and acquainted with disease. He was despised as one from whom men hide their face; and we didn’t respect him.
verses.zh: 他被藐视，被人厌弃；多受痛苦，常经忧患。他被藐视，好像被人掩面不看的一样；我们也不尊重他。

words.g: and + vacant, i.e. ceasing or destitute
and + like + a hider, i.e.  a hiding

verses.en: Surely he has borne our sickness and carried our suffering; yet we considered him plagued, struck by God, and afflicted.
verses.zh: 他诚然担当我们的忧患，背负我们的痛苦；我们却以为他受责罚，被神击打苦待了。

verses.en: But he was pierced for our transgressions. He was crushed for our iniquities. The punishment that brought our peace was on him; and by his wounds we are healed.
verses.zh: 哪知他为我们的过犯受害，为我们的罪孽压伤。因他受的刑罚，我们得平安；因他受的鞭伤，我们得医治。

words.g: and + in + bound , i.e. a weal + +him/his/it

verses.en: All we like sheep have gone astray. Everyone has turned to his own way; and the LORD has laid on him the iniquity of us all.
verses.zh: 我们都如羊走迷；各人偏行己路；耶和华使我们众人的罪孽都归在他身上。

words.g: to vacillate, i.e. reel or stray
to impinge, by accident or violence

verses.en: He was oppressed, yet when he was afflicted he didn’t open his mouth. As a lamb that is led to the slaughter, and as a sheep that before its shearers is silent, so he didn’t open his mouth.
verses.zh: 他被欺压，在受苦的时候却不开口（或译：他受欺压，却自卑不开口）；他像羊羔被牵到宰杀之地，又像羊在剪毛的人手下无声，他也是这样不开口。

words.g: the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +him/his/it
like + a member of a flock, i.e. a sheep or goat
the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +him/his/it

verses.en: He was taken away by oppression and judgment. As for his generation, who considered that he was cut off out of the land of the living and stricken for the disobedience of my people?
verses.zh: 因受欺压和审判，他被夺去，至于他同世的人，谁想他受鞭打、从活人之地被剪除，是因我百姓的罪过呢？

words.g: to ponder, i.e.  converse  or  utter

verses.en: They made his grave with the wicked, and with a rich man in his death, although he had done no violence, nor was any deceit in his mouth.
verses.zh: 他虽然未行强暴，口中也没有诡诈，人还使他与恶人同埋；谁知死的时候与财主同葬。

words.g: in + the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +him/his/it

verses.en: Yet it pleased the LORD to bruise him. He has caused him to suffer. When you make his soul an offering for sin, he will see his offspring. He will prolong his days and the LORD’s pleasure will prosper in his hand.
verses.zh: 耶和华却定意（或译：喜悦）将他压伤，使他受痛苦。耶和华以他为赎罪祭（或译：他献本身为赎罪祭）。他必看见后裔，并且延长年日。耶和华所喜悦的事必在他手中亨通。

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!
to push forward, in various senses

verses.en: After the suffering of his soul, he will see the light and be satisfied. My righteous servant will justify many by the knowledge of himself; and he will bear their iniquities.
verses.zh: 他必看见自己劳苦的功效，便心满意足。有许多人因认识我的义仆得称为义；并且他要担当他们的罪孽。

verses.en: Therefore I will give him a portion with the great. He will divide the plunder with the strong, because he poured out his soul to death and was counted with the transgressors; yet he bore the sins of many and made intercession for the transgressors.
verses.zh: 所以，我要使他与位大的同分，与强盛的均分掳物。因为他将命倾倒，以致于死；他也被列在罪犯之中。他却担当多人的罪，又为罪犯代求。

words.g: and + to + to break away , i.e. trespass
to impinge, by accident or violence

verses.en: “Sing, barren, you who didn’t give birth! Break out into singing, and cry aloud, you who didn’t travail with child! For more are the children of the desolate than the children of the married wife,” says the LORD.
verses.zh: 你这不怀孕、不生养的要歌唱；你这未曾经过产难的要发声歌唱，扬声欢呼；因为没有丈夫的比有丈夫的儿女更多。这是耶和华说的。

words.g: and + to gleam, i.e.  be cheerful
to twist or whirl , i.e.  to dance
to stun , i.e. devastate or  stupefy

verses.en: “Enlarge the place of your tent, and let them stretch out the curtains of your habitations; don’t spare; lengthen your cords, and strengthen your stakes.
verses.zh: 要扩张你帐幕之地，张大你居所的幔子，不要限止；要放长你的绳子，坚固你的橛子。

verses.en: For you will spread out on the right hand and on the left; and your offspring will possess the nations and settle in desolate cities.
verses.zh: 因为你要向左向右开展；你的后裔必得多国为业，又使荒凉的城邑有人居住。

words.g: to stun , i.e. devastate or  stupefy

verses.en: “Don’t be afraid, for you will not be ashamed. Don’t be confounded, for you will not be disappointed. For you will forget the shame of your youth. You will remember the reproach of your widowhood no more.
verses.zh: 不要惧怕，因你必不致蒙羞；也不要抱愧，因你必不致受辱。你必忘记幼年的羞愧，不再记念你寡居的羞辱。

words.g: to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed
to mislay, i.e. to be oblivious of

verses.en: For your Maker is your husband; the LORD of Armies is his name. The Holy One of Israel is your Redeemer. He will be called the God of the whole earth.
verses.zh: 因为造你的是你的丈夫；万军之耶和华是他的名。救赎你的是以色列的圣者；他必称为全地之神。

words.g: a mass of persons , especially reg. organized forwar
and + to be the next of kin + +you/your

verses.en: For the LORD has called you as a wife forsaken and grieved in spirit, even a wife of youth, when she is cast off,” says your God.
verses.zh: 耶和华召你，如召被离弃心中忧伤的妻，就是幼年所娶被弃的妻。这是你神所说的。

words.g: and + to carve, i.e. fabricate or fashion
youth, the state  or the persons

verses.en: “For a small moment I have forsaken you, but I will gather you with great mercies.
verses.zh: 我离弃你不过片时，却要施大恩将你收回。

words.g: in + a wink , i.e. a very short space of time

verses.en: In overflowing wrath I hid my face from you for a moment, but with everlasting loving kindness I will have mercy on you,” says the LORD your Redeemer.
verses.zh: 我的怒气涨溢，顷刻之间向你掩面，却要以永远的慈爱怜恤你。这是耶和华―你的救赎主说的。

words.g: a wink , i.e. a very short space of time
to be the next of kin + +you/your

verses.en: “For this is like the waters of Noah to me; for as I have sworn that the waters of Noah will no more go over the earth, so I have sworn that I will not be angry with you, nor rebuke you.
verses.zh: 这事在我好像挪亚的洪水。我怎样起誓不再使挪亚的洪水漫过遍地，我也照样起誓不再向你发怒，也不斥责你。

words.g: Noach, the patriarch of the flood
Noach, the patriarch of the flood
from + to crack off, i.e.  burst out in rage

verses.en: For the mountains may depart, and the hills be removed, but my loving kindness will not depart from you, and my covenant of peace will not be removed,” says the LORD who has mercy on you.
verses.zh: 大山可以挪开，小山可以迁移；但我的慈爱必不离开你；我平安的约也不迁移。这是怜恤你的耶和华说的。

verses.en: “You afflicted, tossed with storms, and not comforted, behold, I will set your stones in beautiful colors, and lay your foundations with sapphires.
verses.zh: 你这受困苦、被风飘荡不得安慰的人哪，我必以彩色安置你的石头，以蓝宝石立定你的根基；

words.g: in + a gem , probably the sapphire

verses.en: I will make your pinnacles of rubies, your gates of sparkling jewels, and all your walls of precious stones.
verses.zh: 又以红宝石造你的女墙，以红玉造你的城门，以宝石造你四围的边界（或译：外郭）。

words.g: a sparkling gem, probably the ruby
burning, i.e. a carbuncle or other fiery gem

verses.en: All your children will be taught by the LORD, and your children’s peace will be great.
verses.zh: 你的儿女都要受耶和华的教训；你的儿女必大享平安。

verses.en: You will be established in righteousness. You will be far from oppression, for you will not be afraid, and far from terror, for it shall not come near you.
verses.zh: 你必因公义得坚立，必远离欺压，不致害怕；你必远离惊吓，惊吓必不临近你。

words.g: to widen , i.e.  recede or  remove

verses.en: Behold, they may gather together, but not by me. Whoever gathers together against you will fall because of you.
verses.zh: 即或有人聚集，却不由于我；凡聚集攻击你的，必因你仆倒（或译：投降你）。

words.g: to turn aside from the road , i.e. sojourn
to turn aside from the road , i.e. sojourn
to turn aside from the road , i.e. sojourn

verses.en: “Behold, I have created the blacksmith who fans the coals into flame, and forges a weapon for his work; and I have created the destroyer to destroy.
verses.zh: 吹嘘炭火、打造合用器械的铁匠是我所造；残害人、行毁灭的也是我所造。

words.g: a coal, whether charred or live
to + to wind tightly , i.e. to bind

verses.en: No weapon that is formed against you will prevail; and you will condemn every tongue that rises against you in judgment. This is the heritage of the LORD’s servants, and their righteousness is of me,” says the LORD.
verses.zh: 凡为攻击你造成的器械必不利用；凡在审判时兴起用舌攻击你的，你必定他为有罪。这是耶和华仆人的产业，是他们从我所得的义。这是耶和华说的。

words.g: to push forward, in various senses

verses.en: “Hey! Come, everyone who thirsts, to the waters! Come, he who has no money, buy, and eat! Yes, come, buy wine and milk without money and without price.
verses.zh: 你们一切干渴的都当就近水来；没有银钱的也可以来。你们都来，买了吃；不用银钱，不用价值，也来买酒和奶。

verses.en: Why do you spend money for that which is not bread, and your labor for that which doesn’t satisfy? Listen diligently to me, and eat that which is good, and let your soul delight itself in richness.
verses.zh: 你们为何花钱（原文是平银）买那不足为食物的？用劳碌得来的买那不使人饱足的呢？你们要留意听我的话就能吃那美物，得享肥甘，心中喜乐。

words.g: and + to be soft or pliable, i.e.  effeminate or luxurious

verses.en: Turn your ear, and come to me. Hear, and your soul will live. I will make an everlasting covenant with you, even the sure mercies of David.
verses.zh: 你们当就近我来；侧耳而听，就必得活。我必与你们立永约，就是应许大卫那可靠的恩典。

words.g: and + to live, whether literally or figuratively

verses.en: Behold, I have given him for a witness to the peoples, a leader and commander to the peoples.
verses.zh: 我已立他作万民的见证，为万民的君王和司令。

verses.en: Behold, you shall call a nation that you don’t know; and a nation that didn’t know you shall run to you, because of the LORD your God, and for the Holy One of Israel; for he has glorified you.”
verses.zh: 你素不认识的国民，你也必召来；素不认识你的国民也必向你奔跑，都因耶和华―你的神以色列的圣者，因为他已经荣耀你。

verses.en: Seek the LORD while he may be found. Call on him while he is near.
verses.zh: 当趁耶和华可寻找的时候寻找他，相近的时候求告他。

verses.en: Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts. Let him return to the LORD, and he will have mercy on him, to our God, for he will freely pardon.
verses.zh: 恶人当离弃自己的道路；不义的人当除掉自己的意念。归向耶和华，耶和华就必怜恤他；当归向我们的神，因为神必广行赦免。

verses.en: “For my thoughts are not your thoughts, and your ways are not my ways,” says the LORD.
verses.zh: 耶和华说：我的意念非同你们的意念；我的道路非同你们的道路。

verses.en: “For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts.
verses.zh: 天怎样高过地，照样，我的道路高过你们的道路；我的意念高过你们的意念。

words.g: and + a contrivance, i.e.  a texture + +me/my
from + a contrivance, i.e.  a texture + +you/your

verses.en: For as the rain comes down and the snow from the sky, and doesn’t return there, but waters the earth, and makes it grow and bud, and gives seed to the sower and bread to the eater;
verses.zh: 雨雪从天而降，并不返回，却滋润地土，使地上发芽结实，使撒种的有种，使要吃的有粮。

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.en: so is my word that goes out of my mouth: it will not return to me void, but it will accomplish that which I please, and it will prosper in the thing I sent it to do.
verses.zh: 我口所出的话也必如此，决不徒然返回，却要成就我所喜悦的，在我发他去成就（发他去成就：或译所命定）的事上必然亨通。

words.g: from + the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +me/my
used very widely as demonstrative, lo!
and + to push forward, in various senses

verses.en: For you shall go out with joy, and be led out with peace. The mountains and the hills will break out before you into singing; and all the trees of the fields will clap their hands.
verses.zh: 你们必欢欢喜喜而出来，平平安安蒙引导。大山小山必在你们面前发声歌唱；田野的树木也都拍掌。

words.g: to rub or strike the hands together

verses.en: Instead of the thorn the cypress tree will come up; and instead of the brier the myrtle tree will come up. It will make a name for the LORD, for an everlasting sign that will not be cut off.”
verses.zh: 松树长出，代替荆棘；番石榴长出，代替蒺藜。这要为耶和华留名，作为永远的证据，不能剪除。

verses.en: The LORD says: “Maintain justice and do what is right, for my salvation is near and my righteousness will soon be revealed.
verses.zh: 耶和华如此说：你们当守公平，行公义；因我的救恩临近，我的公义将要显现。

verses.en: Blessed is the man who does this, and the son of man who holds it fast; who keeps the Sabbath without profaning it and keeps his hand from doing any evil.”
verses.zh: 谨守安息日而不干犯，禁止己手而不作恶；如此行、如此持守的人便为有福。

words.g: from + to bore, i.e.  to wound + +him/his/it

verses.en: Let no foreigner who has joined himself to the LORD speak, saying, “The LORD will surely separate me from his people.” Do not let the eunuch say, “Behold, I am a dry tree.”
verses.zh: 与耶和华联合的外邦人不要说：耶和华必定将我从他民中分别出来。太监也不要说：我是枯树。

words.g: the + to twine, i.e.  to unite

verses.en: For the LORD says, “To the eunuchs who keep my Sabbaths, choose the things that please me, and hold fast to my covenant,
verses.zh: 因为耶和华如此说：那些谨守我的安息日，拣选我所喜悦的事，持守我约的太监，

verses.en: I will give them in my house and within my walls a memorial and a name better than of sons and of daughters. I will give them an everlasting name that will not be cut off.
verses.zh: 我必使他们在我殿中，在我墙内，有记念，有名号，比有儿女的更美。我必赐他们永远的名，不能剪除。

words.g: and + in + a wall of protection + +me/my

verses.en: Also the foreigners who join themselves to the LORD to serve him, and to love the LORD’s name, to be his servants, everyone who keeps the Sabbath from profaning it, and holds fast my covenant,
verses.zh: 还有那些与耶和华联合的外邦人，要事奉他，要爱耶和华的名，要作他的仆人―就是凡守安息日不干犯，又持守他（原文是我）约的人。

words.g: the + to twine, i.e.  to unite
to + to attend as a menial or worshipper + +him/his/it
and + to + to have affection for
from + to bore, i.e.  to wound + +him/his/it

verses.en: I will bring these to my holy mountain, and make them joyful in my house of prayer. Their burnt offerings and their sacrifices will be accepted on my altar; for my house will be called a house of prayer for all peoples.”
verses.zh: 我必领他们到我的圣山，使他们在祷告我的殿中喜乐。他们的燔祭和平安祭，在我坛上必蒙悦纳，因我的殿必称为万民祷告的殿。

verses.en: The Lord GOD, who gathers the outcasts of Israel, says, “I will yet gather others to him, in addition to his own who are gathered.”
verses.zh: 主耶和华，就是招聚以色列被赶散的，说：在这被招聚的人以外，我还要招聚别人归并他们。

verses.en: All you animals of the field, come to devour, all you animals in the forest.
verses.zh: 田野的诸兽都来吞吃吧！林中的诸兽也要如此。

verses.en: His watchmen are blind. They are all without knowledge. They are all mute dogs. They can’t bark— dreaming, lying down, loving to slumber.
verses.zh: 他看守的人是瞎眼的，都没有知识，都是哑巴狗，不能叫唤；但知做梦，躺卧，贪睡，

words.g: to lean forward, i.e. to peer into the distance + +him/his/it

verses.en: Yes, the dogs are greedy. They can never have enough. They are shepherds who can’t understand. They have all turned to their own way, each one to his gain, from every quarter.
verses.zh: 这些狗贪食，不知饱足。这些牧人不能明白―各人偏行己路，各从各方求自己的利益。

verses.en: “Come,” they say, “I will get wine, and we will fill ourselves with strong drink; and tomorrow will be as today, great beyond measure.”
verses.zh: 他们说：来吧！我去拿酒，我们饱饮浓酒；明日必和今日一样，就是宴乐无量极大之日。

words.g: and + to quaff to satiety, i.e. become tipsy
an intoxicant, i.e. intensely alcoholic liquor

verses.en: The righteous perish, and no one lays it to heart. Merciful men are taken away, and no one considers that the righteous is taken away from the evil.
verses.zh: 义人死亡，无人放在心上；虔诚人被收去，无人思念。这义人被收去是免了将来的祸患；

verses.en: He enters into peace. They rest in their beds, each one who walks in his uprightness.
verses.zh: 他们得享（原文是进入）平安。素行正直的，各人在坟里（原文是床上）安歇。

verses.en: “But draw near here, you sons of a sorceress, you offspring of adulterers and prostitutes.
verses.zh: 你们这些巫婆的儿子，奸夫和妓女的种子，都要前来！

words.g: and + thou and thee, or  ye and you
to act covertly, i.e. practise magic

verses.en: Whom do you mock? Against whom do you make a wide mouth and stick out your tongue? Aren’t you children of disobedience and offspring of falsehood,
verses.zh: 你们向谁戏笑？向谁张口吐舌呢？你们岂不是悖逆的儿女，虚谎的种类呢？

words.g: to be soft or pliable, i.e.  effeminate or luxurious
the mouth , whether literal or figurative
thou and thee, or  ye and you
something born, i.e. a lad or offspring

verses.en: you who inflame yourselves among the oaks, under every green tree; who kill the children in the valleys, under the clefts of the rocks?
verses.zh: 你们在橡树中间，在各青翠树下欲火攻心；在山谷间，在石穴下杀了儿女；

words.g: the + something born, i.e. a lad or offspring
in + a stream, especially a winter torrent
the + a craggy rock, literally or figuratively

verses.en: Among the smooth stones of the valley is your portion. They, they are your lot. You have even poured a drink offering to them. You have offered an offering. Shall I be appeased for these things?
verses.zh: 在谷中光滑石头里有你的分。这些就是你所得的分；你也向他浇了奠祭，献了供物，因这事我岂能容忍吗？

words.g: a stream, especially a winter torrent

verses.en: On a high and lofty mountain you have set your bed. You also went up there to offer sacrifice.
verses.zh: 你在高而又高的山上安设床榻，也上那里去献祭。

verses.en: You have set up your memorial behind the doors and the posts, for you have exposed yourself to someone besides me, and have gone up. You have enlarged your bed and made a covenant for yourself with them. You loved what you saw on their bed.
verses.zh: 你在门后，在门框后，立起你的纪念；向外人赤露，又上去扩张床榻，与他们立约；你在那里看见他们的床就甚喜爱。

words.g: the + something swinging, i.e. the valve of adoor

verses.en: You went to the king with oil, increased your perfumes, sent your ambassadors far off, and degraded yourself even to Sheol.
verses.zh: 你把油带到王那里，又多加香料，打发使者往远方去，自卑自贱直到阴间，

words.g: and + to turn, i.e. travel about

verses.en: You were wearied with the length of your ways; yet you didn’t say, ‘It is in vain.’ You found a reviving of your strength; therefore you weren’t faint.
verses.zh: 你因路远疲倦，却不说这是枉然；你以为有复兴之力，所以不觉疲惫。

verses.en: “Whom have you dreaded and feared, so that you lie, and have not remembered me, nor laid it to your heart? Haven’t I held my peace for a long time, and you don’t fear me?
verses.zh: 你怕谁？因谁恐惧？竟说谎，不记念我，又不将这事放在心上。我不是许久闭口不言，你仍不怕我吗？

verses.en: I will declare your righteousness; and as for your works, they will not benefit you.
verses.zh: 我要指明你的公义；至于你所行的都必与你无益。

verses.en: When you cry, let those whom you have gathered deliver you, but the wind will take them. A breath will carry them all away, but he who takes refuge in me will possess the land, and will inherit my holy mountain.”
verses.zh: 你哀求的时候，让你所聚集的拯救你吧！风要把他们刮散，一口气要把他们都吹去。但那投靠我的必得地土，必承受我的圣山为业。

words.g: to inherit  mode of descent), or  to occupy

verses.en: He will say, “Build up, build up, prepare the way! Remove the stumbling-block out of the way of my people.”
verses.zh: 耶和华要说：你们修筑修筑，预备道路，将绊脚石从我百姓的路中除掉。

words.g: to be high actively, to rise or raise

verses.en: For the high and lofty One who inhabits eternity, whose name is Holy, says: “I dwell in the high and holy place, with him also who is of a contrite and humble spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble, and to revive the heart of the contrite.
verses.zh: 因为那至高至上、永远长存（原文是住在永远）名为圣者的如此说：我住在至高至圣的所在，也与心灵痛悔谦卑的人同居；要使谦卑人的灵苏醒，也使痛悔人的心苏醒。

words.g: to be high actively, to rise or raise
to + to live, whether literally or figuratively
and + to + to live, whether literally or figuratively

verses.en: For I will not contend forever, neither will I always be angry; for the spirit would faint before me, and the souls whom I have made.
verses.zh: 我必不永远相争，也不长久发怒，恐怕我所造的人与灵性都必发昏。

words.g: to + a goal, i.e. the bright object at adistance travelled towards
to crack off, i.e.  burst out in rage

verses.en: I was angry because of the iniquity of his covetousness and struck him. I hid myself and was angry; and he went on backsliding in the way of his heart.
verses.zh: 因他贪婪的罪孽，我就发怒击打他；我向他掩面发怒，他却仍然随心背道。

words.g: to crack off, i.e.  burst out in rage
and + to crack off, i.e.  burst out in rage

verses.en: I have seen his ways, and will heal him. I will lead him also, and restore comforts to him and to his mourners.
verses.zh: 我看见他所行的道，也要医治他；又要引导他，使他和那一同伤心的人再得安慰。

words.g: and + to mend , i.e.  to cure + +him/his/it

verses.en: I create the fruit of the lips: Peace, peace, to him who is far off and to him who is near,” says the LORD; “and I will heal them.”
verses.zh: 我造就嘴唇的果子；愿平安康泰归与远处的人，也归与近处的人；并且我要医治他。这是耶和华说的。

words.g: and + to mend , i.e.  to cure + +him/his/it

verses.en: But the wicked are like the troubled sea; for it can’t rest and its waters cast up mire and mud.
verses.zh: 惟独恶人，好像翻腾的海，不得平静；其中的水常涌出污秽和淤泥来。

verses.en: “There is no peace”, says my God, “for the wicked.”
verses.zh: 我的神说：恶人必不得平安！

verses.en: “Cry aloud! Don’t spare! Lift up your voice like a trumpet! Declare to my people their disobedience, and to the house of Jacob their sins.
verses.zh: 你要大声喊叫，不可止息；扬起声来，好像吹角。向我百姓说明他们的过犯；向雅各家说明他们的罪恶。

words.g: like + a cornet  or curved horn
to be high actively, to rise or raise

verses.en: Yet they seek me daily, and delight to know my ways. As a nation that did righteousness, and didn’t forsake the ordinance of their God, they ask of me righteous judgments. They delight to draw near to God.
verses.zh: 他们天天寻求我，乐意明白我的道，好像行义的国民，不离弃他们神的典章，向我求问公义的判语，喜悦亲近神。

verses.en: ‘Why have we fasted,’ they say, ‘and you don’t see? Why have we afflicted our soul, and you don’t notice?’ “Behold, in the day of your fast you find pleasure, and oppress all your laborers.
verses.zh: 他们说：我们禁食，你为何不看见呢？我们刻苦己心，你为何不理会呢？看哪，你们禁食的日子仍求利益，勒逼人为你们做苦工。

words.g: to cover over , i.e. to fast

verses.en: Behold, you fast for strife and contention, and to strike with the fist of wickedness. You don’t fast today so as to make your voice to be heard on high.
verses.zh: 你们禁食，却互相争竞，以凶恶的拳头打人。你们今日禁食，不得使你们的声音听闻于上。

words.g: to cover over , i.e. to fast
to cover over , i.e. to fast

verses.en: Is this the fast that I have chosen? A day for a man to humble his soul? Is it to bow down his head like a reed, and to spread sackcloth and ashes under himself? Will you call this a fast, and an acceptable day to the LORD?
verses.zh: 这样禁食岂是我所拣选、使人刻苦己心的日子吗？岂是叫人垂头像苇子，用麻布和炉灰铺在他以下吗？你这可称为禁食、为耶和华所悦纳的日子吗？

verses.en: “Isn’t this the fast that I have chosen: to release the bonds of wickedness, to undo the straps of the yoke, to let the oppressed go free, and that you break every yoke?
verses.zh: 我所拣选的禁食不是要松开凶恶的绳，解下轭上的索，使被欺压的得自由，折断一切的轭吗？

words.g: to jump, i.e. be violently agitated
to crack in pieces, literally or figuratively

verses.en: Isn’t it to distribute your bread to the hungry, and that you bring the poor who are cast out to your house? When you see the naked, that you cover him; and that you not hide yourself from your own flesh?
verses.zh: 不是要把你的饼分给饥饿的人，将飘流的穷人接到你家中，见赤身的给他衣服遮体，顾恤自己的骨肉而不掩藏吗？

words.g: to break in pieces, i.e.  to split
and + depressed, in mind or circumstances
to veil from sight, i.e. conceal

verses.zh: 耶和华也必时常引导你，在干旱之地使你心满意足，骨头强壮。你必像浇灌的园子，又像水流不绝的泉源。

verses.zh: 我们摸索墙壁，好像瞎子；我们摸索，如同无目之人。我们晌午绊脚，如在黄昏一样；我们在肥壮人中，像死人一般。

verses.zh: 你虽然被撇弃被厌恶，甚至无人经过，我却使你变为永远的荣华，成为累代的喜乐。

verses.zh: 主耶和华的灵在我身上；因为耶和华用膏膏我，叫我传好信息给谦卑的人（或译：传福音给贫穷的人），差遣我医好伤心的人，报告被掳的得释放，被囚的出监牢；

verses.zh: 赐华冠与锡安悲哀的人，代替灰尘；喜乐油代替悲哀；赞美衣代替忧伤之灵；使他们称为「公义树」，是耶和华所栽的，叫他得荣耀。

verses.zh: 他们的后裔必在列国中被人认识；他们的子孙在众民中也是如此。凡看见他们的必认他们是耶和华赐福的后裔。

verses.zh: 我因耶和华大大欢喜；我的心靠神快乐。因他以拯救为衣给我穿上，以公义为袍给我披上，好像新郎戴上华冠，又像新妇佩戴妆饰。
